br_c01_01.adi.en: This ship is about to enter the atmosphere. Amuro, stand by in the Gundam in case Char attacks.

br_c01_02.adi.en: Would he really try something at a time like this? If he blows it, he'll burn up from atmospheric friction himself.

br_c01_03.adi.en: He'll come. Char's that kind of man.

br_c01_04.adi.en: Listen, even if the enemy comes, you'll be fine as long as you're back before the limit. Watch the time.

br_c01_05.adi.note: Fragmentary transcript ('kiraku ni itte kurete'); read as 'kiraku ni itte kure' - probably Kai teasing Amuro.

br_c02_01.adi.en: The Trojan Horse we've been chasing seems to be heading down to Earth, for the Federation's headquarters at Jaburo.
br_c02_01.adi.note: Mokuba = 'Trojan Horse', the Zeon codename for White Base.

br_c02_02.adi.en: It'd be troublesome to let them get away. This ship has no atmospheric entry capability.

br_c02_03.adi.en: Naturally, I don't intend to let them go. We'll strike right before they enter the atmosphere.

br_c02_05.adi.en: Hit them while they're preparing for atmospheric entry, and they'll find it hard to fight back. And if it does come out, I'll simply turn their new mobile suit into dust in the atmosphere. We have the edge in combat experience, after all.

history.old: Hit them while they're preparing for atmospheric entry, and they'll find it hard to fight back. And if it does come out, I'll simply turn their new mobile suit into dust in the atmosphere. We have the edge in combat experience, after all.
history.reason: Clarity (accuracy note): 'it' pointed forward to the new mobile suit; referent moved first.

br_c02_06.adi.en: No one has ever attacked at a moment like this. I expect you all to fight well.

br_c03_01.adi.en: Zeon has launched a full-scale attack on Jaburo, where we are now. They've never attacked here in force until now. Something may be behind this.

br_c03_03.adi.en: That I can't tell you. But we've been ordered to sortie too. Hayato and Kai, take your Guncannons and intercept the enemies coming in through the nearby entrance. Amuro, take the Gundam and pick off the Gaw attack carriers on the surface.

br_c04_01.adi.en: Now, I'll explain the operation to capture Solomon.

br_c04_02.adi.en: This time the Federation Forces are using a new weapon, the Solar System. Apparently it gathers sunlight with mirrors and fires it like a laser.

br_c04_03.adi.en: Once the Solar System has scorched Solomon's surface and knocked out its defenses, we'll advance close to Solomon.

br_c04_04.adi.en: The Solar System, huh? Will it actually be any use?

br_c04_05.adi.en: Don't ask me. But if we can take Solomon, the balance of power in space will tip heavily in our favor.

br_c04_07.adi.en: Quit grumbling. This is our job, pal.

br_c04_08.adi.en: It's about time. Sortie at once.

br_c05_01.adi.en: At last: the site of the decisive battle, the A Baoa Qu area.

br_c05_02.adi.en: So this is where the enemy's big boss is.

br_c05_03.adi.en: Our point of attack is right where the crossfire comes in. We're clearly short on strength.
br_c05_03.adi.note: Misheard houka (under the gun) -> houka (gunfire), i.e. crossfire; see uncertain.

br_c05_04.adi.en: It'll be fine. This operation will succeed, I'm sure of it.

br_c05_07.adi.en: All right, all hands to first battle stations. We break through the F Line in 10 minutes.

br_c06_01.adi.en: This is it? The Zeong Lady Kycilia mentioned?

br_c06_04.adi.en: Nonsense, sir. Even as it is, the Zeong can deliver 100% of its performance.

br_c06_06.adi.en: Those are just for show. The big shots don't understand that.

br_c06_07.adi.en: I understood how to use it from your explanation, but this psycommu... can I use it?

br_c06_08.adi.en: Your Newtype abilities are an unknown, Colonel. I can't possibly guarantee it.

br_c06_09.adi.en: You're blunt. I don't like that.

br_c06_10.adi.en: Sorry, sir. It may be cold comfort, but I'm sure you'll do fine, Colonel.
br_c06_10.adi.note: 'Doumo' read as an apology for the bluntness.

history.old: Sorry, sir. It may be cold comfort, but I'm sure you'll do fine, Colonel.
history.reason: Standalone 'doumo' is a wry acknowledgement/thanks for being called blunt, not an apology; Char's 'Thank you' answers in kind.

br_c07_01.adi.en: Our 08th Team has pinpointed a site believed to be a Zeon facility. Our investigation confirmed beyond doubt that it's the test site for that mobile armor.
br_c07_01.adi.note: Transcript 'Zeon sabaku-jou' (Zeon desert?) is garbled; read as a suspected Zeon site. See uncertain.

br_c07_02.adi.en: It'll come, I'm sure of it. We'll set traps around here and lie in wait.
br_c07_02.adi.note: 'Karudari' is garbled; read as 'kono atari' (around here). 'Yatsu' = the mobile armor, so 'it'.

br_c07_03.adi.en: Easy for you to say, Captain, but this is day five. This heat is driving me out of my mind.

history.old: Easy for you to say, Captain, but this is day five. This heat is driving me out of my mind.
history.reason: Taichou addressing the player's unit leader (Shiro) = 'Commander' per voice brief.

br_c07_04.adi.en: It'll come. Won't you trust me?

br_c07_05.adi.en: Oh, God... our captain is a demon.

history.old: Oh, God... our captain is a demon.
history.reason: Same taichou rule (Shiro).

br_c07_06.adi.en: Good news! We've got a sonar contact! No doubt about it, it's that thing!

br_c07_07.adi.en: All right! Everyone, get ready to intercept! Stick to the plan!

br_c08_01.adi.en: Lady Aina, are you off to test the Apsaras again?

br_c08_02.adi.en: Norris... Yes. For my brother's dream, to get the Apsaras completed as soon as I possibly can...
br_c08_02.adi.note: Trails off in the source; kept unfinished.

br_c08_03.adi.en: Such dedication, my lady. But if there is anything I, Norris, can do to help, you need only say the word.

br_c08_04.adi.en: Thank you, Norris. But I'll be fine. It's only a flight test and a mega particle cannon firing test, so there's nothing dangerous about it.

br_c08_05.adi.en: If that is so, all is well. But please, do take great care.

history.old: If that is so, all is well. But please, do take great care.
history.reason: 'Sou deshitara yoi no desu ga' expresses hope with doubt; 'all is well' stated it as settled.

br_c09_01.adi.en: HQ has pinpointed the development base of that monster. We're launching an all-out attack.

br_c09_02.adi.en: So we're gonna shell it from long range?

br_c09_03.adi.en: Yeah. Their mobile suits will come out to break up the bombardment, and we'll intercept them. If we let any of them slip past us, we lose.

br_c09_05.adi.en: I'm counting on you all! Take your positions!

br_c09b_01.adi.en: Command has located the base developing that monster. We're launching an all-out attack.
br_c09b_01.adi.note: JP clip ends on 'kake' (verb cut off); completed. 'That monster' kept vague as in JP (likely the Apsalus, 08th MS Team)

br_c09b_02.adi.en: So we're shelling them from the rear with tanks?

br_c09b_03.adi.en: Yeah. Their mobile suits will come out to stop the bombardment, and we'll intercept them. If all three Guntanks are taken out by the enemy, this operation fails.
br_c09b_03.adi.note: ASR 'narimasen' (does not become a failure) contradicts the setup; read as 'narimasu' (= the operation fails)

br_c09b_05.adi.en: I'm counting on you all. Move to guard the tanks at once.

br_c10_01.adi.en: We've failed to secure the Kergeren's escape route. I shall go out myself.

br_c10_02.adi.en: But if you sortie now, you'll never be able to rejoin us!

br_c10_03.adi.en: It doesn't matter. A person's life is measured by what they accomplish. Lord Ginius achieved his dream. That was admirable.
br_c10_03.adi.note: Misheard 'Ginia' -> Ginius; 'sei' read as life - see uncertain.

br_c10_04.adi.en: If your wish, Lady Aina, is for the Kergeren to escape, then helping you is my duty as a soldier.

br_c10_06.adi.en: I'll secure that route splendidly. Watch me.
br_c10_06.adi.note: Source cut off mid-verb ('goran ni ire[mashou]'); meaning is clear.

br_c10_08.adi.note: Garbled low-confidence transcript ('nieva gufukasusamu'); only 'Gouf Custom' is clear. Read as Norris's launch call.

br_c11_01.adi.note: Misheard chuui (caution) -> chuui (Lieutenant), kitaku (go home) -> kita ka (you're here).

br_c11_02.adi.en: It's Zeon. Zeon's using mobile suits right in the city. On top of that, a commando team has broken into the base.

br_c11_03.adi.en: They're after the Alex in this base's G Room, no question. Sortie at once and drive off the enemy mobile suits. We're dealing with the commandos.

br_c11_04.adi.en: Mobile suit combat inside the colony? I object! What about evacuating civilians?

br_c11_05.adi.en: We're doing that! Are you telling me to hand the Alex to the enemy, Lieutenant? The enemy is closing in on us by the minute! Hurry!

br_c12_01.adi.en: Zeon failed twice to destroy the new Gundam being built in this colony, so now they're going to blow the whole colony away with a nuclear missile.

br_c12_02.adi.en: There's only one thing I can do: take down the Gundam before that happens.

br_c12_03.adi.en: My green skills, a single Zaku. Honestly, winning is going to be next to impossible.

history.old: My green skills, a single Zaku. Honestly, winning is going to be next to impossible.
history.reason: Comma-spliced list read as a mistake; ellipsis makes the fragment deliberate.

br_c12_04.adi.en: But I'm not running anymore. Run now and regret it for the rest of my life? No way.

br_c12_05.adi.en: I've prepared all I can. I've set traps too. Smoke flares and balloons will stop it in its tracks, and in that opening I'll land one blow on its weak spot with my heat hawk...
br_c12_05.adi.note: Misheard 'heat fork' -> heat hawk. Trails off in the source; kept unfinished. 'Yatsu' = the Gundam, so 'it'.

br_c12_06.adi.en: Al, Captain Steiner, Misha, Garcia... watch over me.
br_c12_06.adi.note: Cyclops Team names, not in the glossary - see uncertain.

history.old: Al, Captain Steiner, Misha, Garcia... watch over me.
history.reason: Steiner-taichou: match evc145_mih_80, where Misha's taichou to Steiner is 'Commander'.

br_c13_01.adi.en: I'll keep this brief, Lt. Mackenzie.

br_c13_02.adi.en: A single Zaku is heading for this base from the hills. Sortie in the Alex at once.
br_c13_02.adi.note: Misheard ikki (rider) -> ikki (one unit); 'sankanbu' read as mountain area (best guess).

br_c13_04.adi.en: No problem there. You're only up against one unit.

br_c13_05.adi.note: 0.43 s fragment 'yoku'; read as a short acknowledgement ('yoshi' / 'ryoukai'). See uncertain.

br_c14_01.adi.en: The GP02 has attacked the Federation's Naval Review. Its nuclear warhead wiped out more than half the Federation fleet.
br_c14_01.adi.note: Misheard 'kankanshiki' -> kankanshiki (Naval Review). 'Gundam Unit 2' written 'GP02' (see decisions).

br_c14_03.adi.en: Go after the GP02 at once.

br_c14_04.adi.en: The GP02 has appeared near Konpei Island, where the Federation's Naval Review is being held.
br_c14_04.adi.note: Misheard Naval Review and 'Konpeitou-kinkai' (waters near Konpei Island).

br_c14_05.adi.en: He's going after the Naval Review?
br_c14_05.adi.note: 'kankanshiki no kako wo tsukau' is garbled; read as 'is he targeting the Naval Review'. See uncertain.

br_c14_06.adi.en: If we don't stop it fast, it'll be a disaster. Please launch!

br_c14_07.adi.en: Gato! Don't think everything's going to go your way! I'm launching in the Full Burnern!

br_c15_01.adi.en: Major, it's a huge success! The GP02's nuke has wrecked more than half the Federation fleet at the Naval Review.

br_c15_02.adi.en: How feeble. They couldn't even stop a single mobile suit with no weapons.

history.old: How feeble. They couldn't even stop a single mobile suit with no weapons.
history.reason: 'a single mobile suit with no weapons' could attach 'no weapons' to the fleet; clarified.

br_c15_03.adi.en: That's down to your skill, Major.

br_c15_04.adi.en: A unit approaching at high speed! It's a mobile suit!

br_c15_05.adi.en: Oh? So one of them has some backbone. I'll take this one on.

br_c15_06.adi.en: M-Major, please don't push yourself too hard.

history.old: What is their situation?
history.reason: 'What is their situation?' stiff for speech

br_c15b_02.adi.en: As scheduled, the Federation's Naval Review will be held at Solomon.

br_c15b_03.adi.en: Getting cocky, are they? But it's also a golden chance, with the Federation's newest ships all in one place.

br_c15b_04.adi.en: A nuclear warhead to wipe out the Federation battleships in one go. Phase one of Stardust, right?

br_c15b_05.adi.note: 4.7 s clip; transcript has only the unit name + 'launching' (a pilot name may be unheard)

br_c15b_06.adi.en: Take care. I pray for your success.

br_c16_01.adi.en: Solar System II has fired on the colony, which has passed the point of no return.
br_c16_01.adi.note: Misheard shoshi -> soshi genkaiten (interdiction limit / point of no return).

history.old: Solar System II has fired on the colony, which has passed the point of no return.
history.reason: Length: 19.3 -> 17.4 cps, same meaning.

br_c16_02.adi.en: But the colony's still in one piece!

br_c16_03.adi.en: We're preparing a second shot now. Meanwhile, take out every enemy that approaches.

br_c17_01.adi.en: No one can stop the colony now.

br_c17_02.adi.en: Only by seeing this through will others rise to follow after us.

br_c17_04.adi.en: Now all that's left is to settle things with that man.

br_c18_01.adi.en: I meant to defect to the Federation with Delaz as my welcome gift, but to think Gato would get in my way.

br_c18_02.adi.en: Well, never mind. Everything else is going to plan. The colony's set to be destroyed by our hidden ace, the Solar System, after all. Once I've dealt with Gato... What?
br_c18_02.adi.note: Final 'nanda' read as Cima being interrupted by the report in the next row ('What?').

br_c18_03.adi.en: Lady Cima! It's them! The Albion's lot are attacking us...
br_c18_03.adi.note: Cut off in the source; kept unfinished.

br_c18_04.adi.en: What?! What's that Jamitov playing at?!

br_c18_06.adi.en: Ugh, what a pain. Let's wipe them out. Losing here would ruin everything.
br_c18_06.adi.note: Misheard 'motomotomo na' -> moto mo ko mo nai (ruin everything).

br_c19_01.adi.en: This mobile suit's already powered up.

br_c19_02.adi.en: So the data I stole from my old man's computer paid off!

br_c19_03.adi.en: Get out of there now! You can't just move that thing so easily!

br_c19_05.adi.note: Speaker unclear (likely an onlooker reacting to Kamille); see uncertain.

br_c20_02.adi.en: It's the Alexandria. They seem to have found out where the Argama is. They're firing missiles at us.

br_c20_03.adi.en: Damn Titans. They'll hit anything, won't they?

br_c20_04.adi.en: There'll probably be a mobile suit raid. We need to buy time until we can launch. If we take damage here, it could affect the Jaburo offensive.

br_c20_06.adi.en: Mm. I'll launch too once the Hyaku-Shiki's adjustments are done. I'm counting on you.

br_c21_01.adi.en: We've located the Argama, docked at Amman. This is our chance for a surprise attack.

br_c21_02.adi.en: First, the Alexandria, back from Granada, will pin the Argama down with missiles. Meanwhile, you'll close in with mobile suits and sink the Argama.

br_c21_03.adi.en: I'm giving you two of the new Marasai. Interceptor mobile suits will probably come out, but work together and handle it well. That is all.

br_c21_05.adi.en: Roger. At last we can get our revenge on the Argama, Jerid.

br_c21_06.adi.en: Yeah. I'll avenge Lila, no matter what.
br_c21_06.adi.note: Lila Milla Rira; not in the glossary - see uncertain.

br_c22_01.adi.en: With the Jaburo attack over, our forces in space are spread thin. I want to send pilots back to space by shuttle. With Karaba's help, we've secured a shuttle at Kennedy. Using it...
br_c22_01.adi.note: Transcript writes the kanji for sky for 'sora' (space); c23_01 has the same line in katakana. Trails off into the next row.

br_c22_03.adi.en: Mm. I'd like that, but there's word the Titans will target the launch. The pilots giving support have to stay on the ground. This time, staying behind can't be helped.

br_c22_04.adi.en: I'll have Aboly fly the shuttle. We're short-handed, after all. Roberto, Kamille and I will cover the launch in mobile suits.

br_c22_06.adi.en: Understood. I wonder how everyone's doing up in space.
br_c22_06.adi.note: Initial 'saa' might be a mishearing of 'Fa'; see uncertain.

br_c23_01.adi.en: With the Jaburo attack over, our forces in space are spread thin. I want to send pilots back to space by shuttle. With Karaba's help, we've secured a shuttle at Kennedy. Using it...

br_c23_03.adi.en: Mm. I'd like that, but there's word the Titans will target the launch. The pilots giving support have to stay on the ground. This time, staying behind can't be helped.

br_c23_04.adi.en: I'll have Aboly fly the shuttle. We're short-handed, after all. Roberto, Kamille and I will cover the launch in mobile suits.

br_c23_06.adi.en: Understood. I wonder how everyone's doing up in space.

br_c24_01.adi.en: We have to use this fog to get at least Kamille and Captain Quattro back to space. That's Karaba's job, isn't it?

br_c24_03.adi.en: Under cover of the fog, we'll make for the shuttle at Hickory - in mobile suits.

br_c25_01.adi.en: Funny... we're supposed to be enemies.

history.old: Funny... we're supposed to be enemies.
history.reason: Unify c25/c26 (same audio); renders the 'noni ne' contrast without the added 'Funny'.

br_c25_04.adi.en: It's a nice name. I like it.

br_c25_05.adi.en: I hate it. I was the fourth one at the institute, so I'm Four. Number Four.
br_c25_05.adi.note: 'Ima no shisetsu' kept as 'the institute' (Murasame Lab); 'yon' heard as the name Four.

history.old: I hate it. I was the fourth one at the institute, so I'm Four. Number Four.
history.reason: Unify c25/c26 (same audio); keeps 'now' (current institute) and the pause.

history.old: What's your real name?
history.reason: Length: 0.9 s clip, 24 -> 17 cps; same question.

br_c25_07.adi.en: I don't know. I don't have any memories of my past.

br_c25_08.adi.en: Then why not start making memories now?

br_c25_09.adi.note: Low-confidence; 'soro' read as 'sora' (the sky - Kamille noticing aircraft before the next row's bombing). See uncertain.

br_c25_10.adi.en: The Sudori! The Titans are bombing the city! How could they?!

br_c25_11.adi.en: My memories are there... I don't want to be alone!

history.old: My memories are there... I don't want to be alone!
history.reason: Unify with br_c26_11; 'over there' sounds spoken (she is pointing at the plane).

br_c25_12.adi.en: That plane is bringing my memories to me.

br_c25_14.adi.en: Do you know? Do you know who I am?

br_c26_08.adi.en: Then make new memories, starting now!
br_c26_08.adi.note: Kamille; lit. 'You can just make memories from now on, can't you?'

history.reason: Unify with br_c25_08 (same audio); closer to the 'ii ja nai ka' suggestion.

history.old: Hm? That's... Why...?

br_c27_03.adi.en: You... Who are you? You're an enemy, aren't you?

br_c27_04.adi.en: Wake up, Four! It's me! Don't you know me? It's Kamille!

br_c27_05.adi.en: Kamille Bidan is the pilot of the Zeta Gundam. He is recognized as a core AEUG fighter.
br_c27_05.adi.note: Flat data-style recitation, probably Four repeating her programming (speaker not certain). 'Chuukoku' (warning) read as 'chuukaku' (core).

br_c27_06.adi.note: Kamille. Both 'kamin-yu' forms are mis-heard Kamille.

br_c27_11.adi.en: Even in battle, there must be a way to save people. Find it. Let's go.

br_c27_12.adi.en: Captain Quattro's the one being idealistic! I'm going to protect Four!

br_c29_02.adi.en: We of the AEUG will seize Gryps 2, the colony laser Axis took.

br_c29_03.adi.en: Kamille, you go in the first wave, as a decoy in the Zeta.

br_c29_04.adi.en: Meanwhile, Captain Quattro's unit will infiltrate the colony.

br_c29_05.adi.en: Haman may come out. Be careful.

br_c30_01.adi.en: The AEUG fleet has surrounded Gryps.

br_c30_02.adi.en: We're playing their game too much. I can't watch this.
br_c30_02.adi.note: Haman; lit. 'we're being carried along at their pace too much'.

history.old: We're playing their game too much. I can't watch this.
history.reason: Haman's voice: 'playing their game too much' was unidiomatic; same meaning (letting them set the pace).

br_c30_05.adi.en: This feeling... Someone is watching me...
br_c30_05.adi.note: Haman; clip is cut off mid-word, kept trailing.

br_c31_01.adi.en: The battle has reached its peak. We're under attack from both Axis and the Titans. Commander Henken's Radish has gone down too.

br_c31_02.adi.en: There's only one way to break this deadlock. We'll use the colony laser.

br_c31_03.adi.en: Kamille, go and guard the laser cannon. Quattro's unit is already headed there. Earth's fate hangs on this operation. I'm counting on you.
br_c31_03.adi.note: 'Kamui' = mis-heard Kamille; 'ika ni' = ikan ni (depending on).

br_c31_04.adi.en: Four, Sarah, Rosamia, Katz, Captain Henken, Lieutenant Emma... For everyone who's fallen, no matter what, I...
br_c31_04.adi.note: Kamille's monologue, trails off in the source; 'I...' carries the unfinished resolve. 'Zara' = Sarah; 'Emma chuuhi' = Emma chuui. Henken is 'kanchou' (ship captain) here.

br_c32_01.adi.en: The battle has reached its peak. We're under attack from both Axis and the Titans. Commander Henken's Radish has gone down too.
br_c32_01.adi.note: Polite version of c31_01, addressed to Quattro.

br_c32_02.adi.en: There's only one way to break this deadlock. We'll use the Gryps colony laser.

br_c32_04.adi.en: Quattro's unit, please take up guard on the laser cannon. I'll send Kamille's Zeta as well. Earth's fate hangs on this operation. We're counting on you.

br_c33_01.adi.en: Captain, it looks like the AEUG is going to use the colony laser on our fleet.

br_c33_02.adi.en: A natural move. That thing's power is immense. But I won't let them do it.

br_c33_03.adi.en: With His Excellency Jamitov and Colonel Bask gone, you're the only one who can save the Titans, Captain. Please.

br_c34_01.adi.en: Reporting. Both the Titans and our forces are concentrating their attacks on the AEUG.

br_c34_02.adi.en: Because the AEUG now has the colony laser.

br_c34_03.adi.en: What now? Shall we leave the Titans be?

br_c34_04.adi.en: Right now, crushing the AEUG's colony laser is the top priority. But if the laser fires on the Titans fleet, we must consider pulling back for a while. The battle will go on.

br_c34_06.adi.en: I'm going out in the Qubeley. I leave Lady Mineva and the fleet to you.

br_c35_01.adi.en: Looks like Haman means to take Dakar with an Earth descent operation. She's already got her hands on the assembly.
br_c35_01.adi.note: Argama commander (likely Bright). 'Gikai ni te ga mawatte iru' = the assembly has already been got at.

br_c35_02.adi.en: The enemy fleet's trying to land on Earth.

br_c35_03.adi.en: Hold on! If they get down to Earth, what happens to Leina?

br_c35_04.adi.en: First, we'll hit them with mobile suits to keep them from descending. But if they do get down, the Argama will descend to Earth too.

br_c35_05.adi.en: If we talk like that, we'll never save her! Somehow, I'll get Leina off that enemy ship while they're still in space!
br_c35_05.adi.note: Judau. Transcript ends in the imperative 'sukuidase'; the reply 'Fine, go in with that intention' shows Judau is stating his own plan, so read as 'sukuidasu' (I'll rescue).

history.old: If we talk like that, we'll never save her! Somehow, I'll get Leina off that enemy ship while they're still in space!
history.reason: Judau is answering Bright's 'if they land, we follow'; 'If we talk like that' misdirected the retort.

br_c35_06.adi.en: All right. Go in with that in mind. Launch.

br_c35_07.adi.en: The Zeta Gundam's the most agile. I'll take the Zeta. Roux, I'll bring it back in one piece, so swap with me.

br_c36_01.adi.en: We're about to begin the crucial operation to descend to Earth and take Dakar. I won't let them interfere!

br_c36_02.adi.en: Lord Glemy, the Argama has entered the combat zone.

br_c36_03.adi.en: So the Argama's on the move.

br_c36_04.adi.en: Elpeo Ple, can you do this?

br_c36_06.adi.en: What is Judau Ashta to you?

br_c36_07.adi.en: Ngh... Judau is... Judau Ashta is my enemy.
br_c36_07.adi.note: Ple, hesitating. 'Juudou ... ashita' = mis-heard Judau Ashta.

br_c37_01.adi.en: So close, but the Mineva rescue operation's a bust, huh?

br_c37_02.adi.en: Haman found us at the worst moment.

br_c37_03.adi.en: The Nahel Argama and La Vie en Rose are in danger. Let's hurry!

br_c37_04.adi.en: Looks like we've got pursuers, too.

br_c38_01.adi.en: Chara Soon has already led an allied fleet to Axis to crush Glemy. Our goal is to support her from the rear and, with luck, be the vanguard in retaking Axis. Do not underestimate the enemy. Axis's Newtype unit is said to be far stronger than the Gundam Team. Brave warriors of the Endra! Who among you will make a name for yourself? Show no mercy to anyone who sides with Glemy, whoever it may be - even if it is a former comrade. Fate will surely bring Lady Haman a glorious victory. Evil will be repaid with evil, and sin with sin!
br_c38_01.adi.note: Endra commander's address to the crew (Mashymre-style devotion to Haman; speaker not confirmed). 43.6 s, long but within reading rate.

br_c38_02.adi.en: Evil will be repaid with evil, and sin with sin!
br_c38_02.adi.note: Crew chanting the commander's closing line.

br_c38_03.adi.en: Evil will be repaid with evil, and sin with sin!

br_c39_03.adi.en: Does he want to die? Let's go!
br_c39_03.adi.note: 'Shinu tsumori na no?' read as about Judau (who just went into Axis), not about the listener. Likely Roux.

br_c39_04.adi.note: Grunt; the transcript is a long held 'unuu' sound.

br_c40_01.adi.en: The Glemy Faction's been wiped out, but Haman isn't making a move.

br_c40_02.adi.en: Seems enemies are hiding behind Core 3, but...

history.old: Seems enemies are hiding behind Core 3, but...
history.reason: 'Seems enemies are hiding' unnatural.

br_c40_04.adi.en: Are they watching what we do?

br_c40_05.adi.en: She's waiting for me. Haman's matching our moves, just quietly waiting for me.

br_c40_06.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR ('sonna'); a dismayed protest, rendered short.

br_c40_07.adi.en: I can tell. I don't want any more blood spilled for nothing. Haman and I will settle this. That's what Haman wants, too.

br_c40_08.adi.en: I'll finish it this time. I'm going.

br_c41_01.adi.en: Lady Haman, is it really all right not to move the troops?

br_c41_02.adi.en: Judau and I will settle this one-on-one.

br_c41_03.adi.en: Lady Haman, surely you won't go out alone...

br_c41_04.adi.en: Do not worry. He's coming alone, too.
br_c41_04.adi.note: Haman; 'ikki' read as ikki (single rider). He = Judau.

br_c41_06.adi.en: Fear not. Judau is already bound to my will.

br_c41_07.adi.en: Judau Ashta... A mere child, yet he made me want to wear a normal suit. Qubeley, launching!
br_c41_07.adi.note: Haman. 'Juudou wo aishita' = mis-heard Judau Ashta (not 'loved Judau'). 'Normal suit' is the in-universe term for a pilot suit.

br_c42_01.adi.en: Char has made his move. A little over a week after the Sweetwater declaration, he's finally begun military action. He's trying to drop Fifth Luna on Earth.

br_c42_02.adi.en: For two years we've searched every colony and found no sign of Char's arms buildup, and now he suddenly drops a rock on Earth! What's he thinking?!
br_c42_02.adi.note: 'Inseki otoshi' = meteor/asteroid drop; rendered 'drops a rock'.

br_c42_03.adi.en: We're out of time, but we have to stop it no matter what.

br_c42_04.adi.en: That's our job - Londo Bell's. I'm taking the Re-GZ out.

br_c42_05.adi.en: The odds of making it in time are low, but do everything you can. I'm counting on you.

br_c43_02.adi.en: Fifth Luna: entry angle good, velocity good.

br_c43_03.adi.en: Colonel, Gyunei Guss's sector is in a stalemate. I believe he needs support.

br_c43_04.adi.en: Fifth Luna's insertion is done. Signal all units to withdraw.
br_c43_04.adi.note: Char. The reply 'we've sent it' shows this is an order.

br_c43_05.adi.en: It's been sent. We can also scatter Minovsky particles and jam the radar to cover the mobile suits' retreat.
br_c43_05.adi.note: 'Koutai' read as retreat (not shift change), which Char's reply (more danger for Gyunei) confirms.

br_c43_06.adi.en: Which puts Gyunei in more danger... Very well.

br_c43_07.adi.en: I'll cover and recover Gyunei's Jagd Doga. Sazabi, launching!

br_c44_01.adi.en: Our fleet will make a second attack at the exact midpoint of the trajectory. But Axis could detonate the nukes they brought from Luna II near the surface and plunge Earth into nuclear winter.

br_c44_02.adi.en: So in this attack, we'll destroy Axis's nozzles and destroy Axis itself.

history.old: So in this attack, we'll destroy Axis's nozzles and destroy Axis itself.
history.reason: Removed repeated 'destroy'.

br_c44_03.adi.en: Which means a fleet attack is all we have. And we've only got four nuclear missiles left.

br_c44_04.adi.en: So if that attack fails, we board Axis and blow up this section from inside. The tunnels here run like a net, so splitting Axis is possible.

br_c44_05.adi.en: Then the fragments of Axis will fly out of the Earth Sphere.

br_c44_06.adi.en: Right, a three-stage plan. We'll settle this before enemy reinforcements come from Luna II.

br_c44_07.adi.en: I'm sorry... but I need all your lives.
br_c44_07.adi.note: Bright; his famous CCA line, clip cut short.

br_c45_03.adi.en: Good. Set the nuke to detonate just before it hits Earth. We'll take the crew aboard.
br_c45_03.adi.note: Speaker change inside the clip is possible (polite final verb); rendered as one voice.

br_c45_04.adi.en: Colonel, I won't try to stop you anymore, but after you defeat Amuro...

br_c45_05.adi.en: Yes. After that, I'll do as you say, Nanai. Go to the combat bridge.
br_c45_05.adi.note: Char. Transcript 'haitte kuru' (I'll go in) read as an order to Nanai, which her 'Yes' and his 'Good girl' confirm; Char himself is launching to fight Amuro.

br_c46_01.adi.en: Enemy approaching! Mobile suits, launch! Don't let them near the Space Ark!

br_c46_03.adi.en: Mobile suits, keep them away from this ship!

br_c46_04.adi.en: Keep moving and you won't die.
br_c46_04.adi.note: Lit. 'if you keep running around, you won't die.'

br_c46_05.adi.en: Seabook?! What took you so long?!

br_c46_06.adi.note: Transcript 'dassou' (desert) makes no sense here; read as a launch order (exact verb uncertain).

br_c47_02.adi.en: Seems they broke our line on the mine side.
br_c47_02.adi.note: 'Kouzan-gawa' (mine side) kept as heard; could be a mis-hearing of 'kouwan-gawa' (port side).

br_c47_03.adi.en: They're fast. Big Jegan types won't cut it.

br_c47_04.adi.en: Anna Mary's out ahead. Join her and attack together.

br_c47_06.adi.en: Mobile suit units, launch in order!

br_c48_01.adi.en: Our unit will storm the colony to seize Frontier I.

br_c48_02.adi.en: Note that Lady Berah will be accompanying us this time. Do not take your eyes off her for a moment.

br_c48_03.adi.en: I'll be learning from you, Zabine.

br_c48_04.adi.en: A fine chance to show what we of the Black Vanguard can do. That is all. All units, sortie!

br_c49_01.adi.en: Iron Mask... It's your father we're up against, Cecily. Are you okay?

br_c49_02.adi.en: A man who can't do anything without wearing a mask... and he talks of setting the world right.

br_c49_03.adi.en: Wiping out humanity with unmanned weapons... Anyone who could plan that is a scary enemy.

br_c49_05.adi.en: Seems the Moon reinforcements were wiped out. I'd like to call it even, but...

br_c49_06.adi.en: That's why we have to strike that man, isn't it?

br_c49_08.adi.en: To me, it feels like an evil spirit disturbing the universe.

br_c50_01.adi.en: Iron Mask... It's your father we're up against, Cecily. Are you okay?

br_c50_02.adi.en: A man who can't do anything without wearing a mask... and he talks of setting the world right.

br_c50_03.adi.en: Wiping out humanity with unmanned weapons... Anyone who could plan that is a scary enemy.

br_c50_04.adi.note: Cecily. Low-confidence ASR heard 'e, teki'; c50 is otherwise the same scene as c49, so read as the same line as br_c49_04.

br_c50_05.adi.en: Seems the Moon reinforcements were wiped out. I'd like to call it even, but...

br_c50_06.adi.en: That's why we have to strike that man, isn't it?

br_c50_08.adi.en: To me, it feels like an evil spirit disturbing the universe.

br_c51_03.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR; 'yonde kuru' read as 'yonde iru'. Object 'me' inferred.

br_c51_04.adi.en: Who is it? What is this place?

br_c51_05.adi.en: It's cold... Is this what they call the afterlife?

br_c51_07.adi.note: Lit. 'I'm riding a machine.' Speaker unidentified (uses 'ore').

br_p10_01.adi.en: Everyone's here. All right, listen up, all of you.

history.old: Everyone's here. All right, listen up, all of you.
history.reason: 'Everyone ... all of you' redundant

br_p10_02.adi.en: The battle with the Jupiter Empire is finally reaching its climax. Crux Dogatie reached Earth ahead of us and is now pretending to be friendly toward it. There's no doubt he'll show his true colors and start attacking Earth sooner or later, but before that, he'll probably strike at us first.
br_p10_02.adi.note: 'Crux Dogatie' not in glossary (Gundam Wiki spelling, male canon character)

br_p10_03.adi.en: So they'll set an ambush before the Mother Vanguard reaches Earth?

br_p10_04.adi.en: Probably. And they may have built up their forces on Earth, too.

br_p10_05.adi.en: You, the aces of this ship, must repel that attack no matter what. It will be a hard fight, but please, we're counting on you.
br_p10_05.adi.note: 'onegai shimasu' from the ship's operator: 'we' (the ship) asking the aces

br_p1a_01.adi.en: So, Commander, Command has already handed our unit a mission.
br_p1a_01.adi.note: taichou (addressing Kamuna, the unit leader) = 'Commander' throughout

br_p1a_02.adi.en: Oh? Where are we being sent? Asia? Or space?

history.old: Huh, defense reserve? How boring.
history.reason: bare 'defense reserve?' unclear; she is inferring their role from 'right here, at Jaburo'

br_p1a_05.adi.en: The thing is, Intelligence reports that Zeon is about to launch a full-scale attack right here on Jaburo.

br_p1a_06.adi.en: From what we know so far, it's a large force of over ten Gaw attack carriers.

br_p1a_07.adi.en: Huh, not bad, Zeon. So our mission is to intercept them in our mobile suits?

br_p1a_08.adi.en: Yes. Our mission this time is to intercept, from the ground, the mobile suits dropping from the Gaws and the Gaws themselves. Few GMs have been deployed yet, and the HQ pilots aren't very well trained, so I think this is our unit's chance to shine.

history.old: Yes. Our mission this time is to intercept, from the ground, the mobile suits dropping from the Gaws and the Gaws themselves. Few GMs have been deployed yet, and the HQ pilots aren't very well trained, so I think this is our unit's chance to shine.
history.reason: 'intercept, from the ground, the mobile suits...' interrupted object hard to parse

br_p1a_09.adi.en: I see. Understood. Then we sortie. Everyone, take your positions in your mobile suits.
br_p1a_09.adi.note: ASR 'hitsuyou da' (it's necessary) = shutsugeki da (we sortie), as in p1b_09

br_p1b_01.adi.en: Commander, Command has already handed our unit a mission.

br_p1b_02.adi.en: Sent to North America, so it's got to be...

br_p1b_03.adi.en: Yes. We're joining the Jaburo attack force.

br_p1b_04.adi.en: Striking the enemy's home base directly, huh? That's a tough one.

br_p1b_05.adi.en: Apparently the operation was drawn up after Colonel Char Aznable, the Red Comet under Major General Kycilia, finally found a secret entrance to Jaburo.

br_p1b_06.adi.en: I'd heard he'd been sidelined, but that's the Red Comet for you.

br_p1b_07.adi.en: Colonel Char will infiltrate underground and seize HQ while creating diversions and confusion. Our objective, as the ground assault force, is to drop from the Gaws and destroy the enemy's ground batteries and catapults.

br_p1b_08.adi.en: I see. A two-pronged attack with Colonel Char might just work.

br_p1b_09.adi.en: I see. Understood. Then let's move out. Everyone, load your mobile suits onto the Gaws.

br_p2a_01.adi.en: This is it. We're entering the space around A Baoa Qu.

br_p2a_02.adi.en: Our side lost a third of the fleet to the enemy's Solar Ray. We managed to regroup and make it this far, but can we win?

br_p2a_03.adi.en: Yeah... but we have to avenge General Revil.
br_p2a_03.adi.note: ASR 'teki wo utsu' (shoot the enemy) = kataki wo utsu (avenge); long 'aaaa' read as a drawn-out 'yeah'

br_p2a_04.adi.en: Take A Baoa Qu, and Side 3 is as good as defenseless. Zeon should agree to peace talks. In effect, this ought to be the final battle. It'll be all-out war.

br_p2a_06.adi.en: Many new models seem to be deployed around the carrier Dolos. But in numbers, the Federation still has the edge.

br_p2a_07.adi.en: I see. We've come this far. Let's win and go home. Everyone, to your positions!

br_p2b_01.adi.en: Mankind can survive for eternity only when it is managed and governed by us, the chosen superior race: the people of Zeon! We must teach the incompetent fools of the Earth Federation a lesson. For the sake of tomorrow's future, we, the people of Zeon, must rise up!
br_p2b_01.adi.note: Gihren's broadcast speech. ASR 'yuuryou-shu' as 'paid owner' = yuuryoushu (superior race)

br_p2b_02.adi.en: That's the end of the footage of His Excellency Gihren's speech. The Federation fleet will soon enter the space around A Baoa Qu.

br_p2b_03.adi.en: The enemy lost a third of its fleet and General Revil to the Solar Ray, right? It won't go like Solomon this time.

br_p2b_04.adi.en: And for us, this is a battle to avenge Lt. General Dozle.

br_p2b_05.adi.en: If we wipe out the enemy fleet here, the Federation's remaining forces will be quite small. That will buy us a lot of time, and then Zeon, with its superior technology, can very well make a comeback.

history.old: If we wipe out the enemy fleet here, the Federation's remaining forces will be quite small. That will buy us a lot of time, and then Zeon, with its superior technology, can very well make a comeback.
history.reason: 'can very well make' unidiomatic

br_p2b_06.adi.en: And we still have Major General Kycilia's Granada forces somewhat in reserve.

history.old: And we still have Major General Kycilia's Granada forces somewhat in reserve.
history.reason: 'somewhat in reserve' awkward

br_p2b_07.adi.en: Our forces are centered on two Dolos-class carriers, with our newest Gelgoogs deployed. In overall strength we should have the upper hand. Let's win!
br_p2b_07.adi.note: '2-seki no kuubo Dolos' rendered 'two Dolos-class carriers'

br_p2b_08.adi.en: Yeah. If we lose here, there's nothing left. Let's give it everything we've got. Everyone, to your positions!

br_p3a_01.adi.en: We've caught up with the Albion. Time to launch.

br_p3a_02.adi.en: So we'll be clashing with the Delaz Fleet's main force.

br_p3a_03.adi.en: Ensign Uraki has gone ahead in the Gundam GP03 and is attacking the colony. We'll work with the Albion to hit the enemies in this sector so they can't join up against Ensign Uraki.

history.old: Ensign Uraki has gone ahead in the Gundam GP03 and is attacking the colony. We'll work with the Albion to hit the enemies in this sector so they can't join up against Ensign Uraki.
history.reason: 'join up against' unclear

br_p3a_04.adi.en: First real combat in ages. I'm itching to go.

br_p3a_05.adi.en: It's been three years since A Baoa Qu. Things have been pretty dull. I'm glad I get to fight with Tachibana's unit again.

br_p3a_06.adi.en: Most enemy suits are old models, but don't underestimate their pilots' morale and teamwork. Be careful.

br_p3a_07.adi.en: We can't let them drop the colony on Jaburo. Let's show them our unit hasn't gone rusty. Everyone, to your positions!

br_p3b_01.adi.en: Here's the current situation. Major Gato's advance force is attacking the enemy's main defense force to drop the colony on Earth. We, with the Delaz Fleet's main body, are moving to join them later.

history.old: Here's the current situation. Major Gato's advance force is attacking the enemy's main defense force to drop the colony on Earth. We, with the Delaz Fleet's main body, are moving to join them later.
history.reason: 'We, with the Delaz Fleet's main body, are moving' clumsy

br_p3b_03.adi.en: We'll soon run into the enemy's strike force. Our unit's mission is to destroy it.

br_p3b_04.adi.en: A strike force, huh? That'd be that Albion thing.

br_p3b_05.adi.en: The Albion's main strength, which looks like a new Gundam, will probably engage Major Gato, who's gone ahead. We'll pin down the remaining warships and the GM squads.

br_p3b_06.adi.en: Three years since A Baoa Qu. All that time we patiently lay low comes down to this. This is a crucial moment if the colony drop is to succeed, Commander.
br_p3b_06.adi.note: ASR 'shifuku' (bliss) = shifuku (lying low); 'seika' (result) phrasing kept as 'comes down to this'

br_p3b_07.adi.en: For the revival of Zeon, for His Excellency Delaz who called us back, and for our own pride, we'll see this colony drop through to success. Ellen, Shirley, Pamir, I'm counting on you again.
br_p3b_07.adi.note: ASR 'Famiru' = Pamir (unit member, cf. v03 br_p6b_08 'Shirley, Pamir')

br_p4a_01.adi.en: This mission is to support the shuttle launch at Kennedy Spaceport.

br_p4a_02.adi.en: Sending the Second Battle of Jaburo units back to space, huh?
br_p4a_02.adi.note: glossary binds 'Jaburo koka sakusen' to 'Second Battle of Jaburo'

history.old: Sending the Second Battle of Jaburo units back to space, huh?
history.reason: accuracy note: 'the Second Battle of Jaburo units' compressed; glossary term kept

br_p4a_03.adi.en: Yes. The Argama group in space is badly short-handed right now, so this shuttle launch is important. But a Titans unit from Augusta is certain to come and interfere.
br_p4a_03.adi.note: 'Augusta' (Titans Newtype lab base) not in glossary

br_p4a_04.adi.en: Those guys don't care who gets hurt.

br_p4a_05.adi.en: Anyway, the key is to keep the enemy away from the shuttle and strike first to intercept them.

br_p4a_06.adi.en: The target's big, so defending it will be tough too.

br_p4a_07.adi.en: This is the most important mission we've had since we joined the AEUG. Let's really make our mark here.

br_p4a_08.adi.en: We joined the AEUG to crush the vile ambitions of the Titans. We'll make this mission a success even if it means putting our lives on the line. I'm counting on you all.

br_p4b_01.adi.en: We have our orders. We're to help pursue the Argama, the AEUG flagship that fled into Hong Kong City.

br_p4b_02.adi.en: Hong Kong... I've heard of it. The Luo Company, was it? Word is they're secretly helping the AEUG and Karaba.
br_p4b_02.adi.note: ASR 'konkon' = Honkon; 'Luo Company' not in glossary

br_p4b_03.adi.en: Yes. Because the Argama is under the Luo Company's protection, it seems they're having a hard time catching the enemy.

br_p4b_05.adi.en: The Psycho Gundam will destroy the Luo Company's facilities. That's expected to draw out AEUG and Karaba mobile suits, and we'll engage them.

br_p4b_07.adi.en: We're told the Psycho Gundam is piloted by a Cyber Newtype from the Murasame Lab near Hong Kong. Support it and wipe out the enemy.
br_p4b_07.adi.note: 'Murasame Lab' not in glossary; ASR 'toujou' (appear) = toujou (board)

br_p4b_08.adi.en: A Cyber Newtype... So the pilot's a test subject. I just don't like it.

br_p4b_09.adi.en: True, I'm not keen on it either. But now that we're in the Titans, we've got no choice but to follow orders from above. All right, Tachibana's unit, prepare to sortie!

br_p4c_02.adi.en: It's been a while. Give us the details.

br_p4c_03.adi.en: Yes. I'll explain why Tachibana's unit is reforming in Africa, on Earth.

br_p4c_05.adi.en: A month ago, Commander Tachibana received secret orders from Lady Haman of Axis. The orders: support the Zeon remnant forces in Africa.

br_p4c_06.adi.en: Support? What exactly are we doing?

br_p4c_07.adi.en: With help from Zeon remnant groups all over Earth, we've finally secured the mobile suits the operation needs. Here, we'll launch a counteroffensive to seize a former Zeon base taken over by the Federation Forces.

br_p4c_08.adi.en: So it's an uprising timed to the arrival of Lady Haman's main force from Axis in the Earth Sphere.

br_p4c_09.adi.en: Yes. For the revival of Zeon, we'll carry out a two-front operation in space and on the ground. Many Zeon remnants on the ground are still waiting for their chance. As their spearhead, if we don't make this operation succeed...
br_p4c_09.adi.note: ASR 'senpou' (tactic) = senpou (spearhead); JP trails off, kept unfinished

br_p4c_10.adi.en: I've called you together after all this time, and it's going to be a tough operation. Give me your lives.

br_p4c_11.adi.en: What are you saying? We'll follow you anywhere, Commander.

br_p4c_12.adi.en: That's right! Just leave it to us!

br_p5a_01.adi.en: This is it. Now I'll explain our role in this operation.

br_p5a_02.adi.en: In Operation Maelstrom, our forces seized the colony laser from Axis. To settle the fight with the Titans, we'll use this colony laser on the enemy fleet.

br_p5a_03.adi.note: asr low; 0.7 s exclamation, reaction to the briefing

br_p5a_04.adi.en: Until the colony laser fires, we'll intercept the Titans as they attack to recapture or destroy it.

br_p5a_05.adi.en: I see. If this operation succeeds, the Titans are sure to collapse.

br_p5a_06.adi.en: The colony laser is powerful enough to change the course of a falling Axis. Get caught in the blast and you won't stand a chance. We need to finish off the enemy attack force early.
br_p5a_06.adi.note: 'Axis rakka shinro' read as the course of Axis as it falls; exact referent uncertain

br_p5a_08.adi.en: This will probably be our last fight with the Titans. We absolutely can't fail. But we've pulled together and made it through life-or-death battles many times. This operation will succeed too.

br_p5a_09.adi.en: Right, we'll be fine. Well, I always think things will work out.

br_p5a_10.adi.en: That's right. Let's keep calm, same as always.

br_p5b_01.adi.en: I'll explain our role in this operation.

br_p5b_02.adi.en: Our Gryps 2 colony laser was stolen by Axis, and then seized by the AEUG. Retaking this laser cannon for us, the Titans: that's the core of the operation.
br_p5b_02.adi.note: ASR 'koushi' (exercise) read as kosshi (core/outline); best fit

br_p5b_03.adi.en: Well, naturally. Stealing stuff other people made isn't nice, right?

br_p5b_04.adi.en: The AEUG will probably fire the laser at our fleet base next. If that happens, we won't have the strength left to stand against the AEUG and Axis.

br_p5b_05.adi.en: The Titans have lost Brigadier General Jamitov and Colonel Bask, and morale is in the gutter. For the enemy, the timing couldn't be better.
br_p5b_05.adi.note: ASR 'junshou' = junshou (brigadier general, as spoken); 'iki shouchin' (dispirited)

br_p5b_06.adi.en: Our unit's orders are to bypass the enemy's main fleet, which is likely defending the laser, and strike the other AEUG fleets.

br_p5b_08.adi.en: Those are Captain Paptimus Scirocco's orders. But...

br_p5b_09.adi.en: Scirocco doesn't think much of us. And I don't trust him either. Well, there's no point thinking too hard about it. It's not like we're going in planning to lose. Let's sortie!

br_p5c_02.adi.en: The Gryps 2 colony laser our forces seized from the Titans was taken by the AEUG, and it was used to stop our operation to drop Axis. The colony laser is still in AEUG hands, and there's no doubt they'll use it again soon.

br_p5c_03.adi.en: Will they fire it at us, the Axis forces?

br_p5c_04.adi.en: No. Having lost Jamitov and Bask, the Titans have lost the will to fight. Our leadership believes the AEUG will likely fire the laser at the Titans to settle things with them.

br_p5c_05.adi.en: Makes sense. Once the Titans collapse, the whole Earth Federation will unite behind the AEUG.

br_p5c_06.adi.en: So our forces will make retaking or destroying the colony laser our first objective, while also aiming to wipe out the Titans. Tachibana's unit will fight the Titans' reserve forces and support the colony laser capture team led by Lady Haman.

br_p5c_07.adi.en: So there's no chance of us getting hit by the laser, then.

br_p5c_08.adi.en: That's right. But we'll be up against Titans units with nothing left to lose, so they'll fight with their backs to the wall. Don't let your guard down.

br_p5c_09.adi.en: Right, understood. If we hit the Titans and the AEUG wears itself out too, Axis should be able to take the lead after that. Everyone, let's sortie!

br_p6a_01.adi.en: Welcome back, Commander. Are you fully recovered?

br_p6a_02.adi.en: Sorry for all the trouble, everyone. I'm fully healed now. Brief me on the operation.

br_p6a_03.adi.en: During the year you were recovering, Commander, our AEUG kept fighting Axis despite our small numbers. And now, at last, a once-in-a-lifetime chance to bring down Haman has come.

br_p6a_04.adi.en: The Glemy Faction, which broke away in Axis's internal split, was crushed in the recent battle. Haman's side has also used up its strength and is finally preparing for a final battle at its base, Core 3.
br_p6a_04.adi.note: 'sengoku no tatakai' read as 'the recent battle' (sakki/senjitsu); exact word uncertain

br_p6a_05.adi.en: Our unit will provide support fire for the Nahel Argama group, the main force in the decisive battle. The AEUG and Federation main fleet is also set to depart Earth, but it doesn't look like it'll make it in time. So we'll reach the battlefield first in a fast ship and join the front line.

br_p6a_06.adi.en: Haman herself wants a one-on-one duel with Judau Ashta's ZZ, and her own aides' units don't seem to plan on moving. However, there's a high chance some officers acting on their own, or Glemy Faction remnants, will go after the Nahel Argama.

br_p6a_07.adi.en: If we win this, the long war between the Federation and Zeon will finally be over.

br_p6a_08.adi.en: Yes. Looking back, it's been a long war. Eight years as this unit's operator, and to end it...
br_p6a_08.adi.note: Whisper looped the last phrase ('to end our fight') many times over a 6 s clip; only the opening is reliable. Ending left trailing

br_p6a_09.adi.en: Shirley, Ellen, it's too early to get sentimental. First, we win. Tachibana's unit, sortieing for the first time in a year!

br_p6a_10.adi.en: Ah, this is it! This is what I've been missing! Roger!

br_p6b_01.adi.en: Welcome back, Commander. We've all been waiting.

br_p6b_02.adi.en: Sitting things out was hard on me too. I'm fully healed now. Brief me on the operation.

br_p6b_03.adi.en: During the year or so you were out with your injury, Commander, our Axis steadily pressed on with conquering the Earth Sphere. But as you know, Glemy Toto rebelled, and Axis split in two.

br_p6b_04.adi.en: But their side is mostly Glemy's private troops, while ours still has Lady Haman's trusted officers and men. Now, while Glemy is in chaos fighting the Nahel Argama, is our chance to strike the Glemy Faction.
br_p6b_04.adi.note: ASR 'shihei' (banknotes) = shihei (private troops); 'kokou' (aloof) read as kokou (trusted right-hand); 'kokou' could also be a veteran-sense word

history.old: But their side is mostly Glemy's private troops, while ours still has Lady Haman's trusted officers and men. Now, while Glemy is in chaos fighting the Nahel Argama, is our chance to strike the Glemy Faction.
history.reason: 'Now, while X, is our chance' did not parse when spoken; restructured, same meaning.

br_p6b_05.adi.en: Glemy was too young after all. He brought it on himself.

br_p6b_06.adi.en: We'll take on one of the units forming a wing of the Glemy Faction.

br_p6b_07.adi.en: They can't know yet that Captain Kamuna is back. Let's show them how a real unit fights!

history.old: They can't know yet that Captain Kamuna is back. Let's show them how a real unit fights!
history.reason: Taichou addressing/naming Kamuna = 'Commander' (voice brief decision; v03 wrote Captain).

br_p6b_08.adi.en: Right. It's my first real fight in a while, but I mean to make up for the whole year. Shirley, Pamir, I'm counting on you again.

br_p7a_01.adi.en: Good to see you again, Captain. I'm glad too that Tachibana's unit is back together like this.
br_p7a_01.adi.note: 'Tachibana-tai' rendered 'Tachibana's unit' as in the mission intros (S02455).

history.old: Good to see you again, Captain. I'm glad too that Tachibana's unit is back together like this.
history.reason: Taichou to Kamuna = 'Commander'.

br_p7a_02.adi.en: Heh heh. It's been a while since humanity was in real danger. Things can't get started without us!

br_p7a_03.adi.en: We're all seasoned veterans now, after all. You twisted someone's arm to get us again, didn't you, Captain?

history.old: We're all seasoned veterans now, after all. You twisted someone's arm to get us again, didn't you, Captain?
history.reason: Taichou to Kamuna = 'Commander'.

br_p7a_04.adi.en: Humanity in danger - yes. A large-scale destruction operation to rival the great wars of the past is about to be carried out. Char Aznable's Neo Zeon got hold of the asteroid Axis through a backroom deal, and by treachery means to drop Axis onto Earth.

history.old: Humanity in danger - yes. A large-scale destruction operation to rival the great wars of the past is about to be carried out. Char Aznable's Neo Zeon got hold of the asteroid Axis through a backroom deal, and by treachery means to drop Axis onto Earth.
history.reason: 'by treachery means to drop' was stilted; smoother wording, repeated 'Axis' replaced by 'it'.

br_p7a_05.adi.en: Char said he'd make Earth a planet people can't live on. He seems dead serious about it.

br_p7a_06.adi.en: Our mission is to stop the Axis drop. We'll fight the enemy mobile suit forces alongside Captain Amuro Ray and the others. Meanwhile, an engineering team will plant bombs inside Axis and blow it up before it starts falling toward Earth.
br_p7a_06.adi.note: Misheard taiin -> taii (Amuro is a Captain in CCA); 'gun' (army) -> 'gun' (group).

br_p7a_07.adi.en: Humans passing judgment on humanity? We have to stop Char from doing as he pleases. All of you, take your positions!

history.old: Humans passing judgment on humanity? We have to stop Char from doing as he pleases. All of you, take your positions!
history.reason: Source says 'punish' (batsu wo ataeru); 'passing judgment' weakened it.

br_p7b_01.adi.en: It's time. Colonel Char has ordered all forces to sortie.

br_p7b_02.adi.en: Operation Earth Cooling, the Axis drop, is now beginning. Neo Zeon's true aim is to drop an asteroid on Earth, wreck its natural environment, and make the people clinging to Earth emigrate to space.

br_p7b_03.adi.en: Mm. It's a brutal plan, but if humanity keeps polluting Earth like this, I think it'll come to the same thing sooner or later. In that case, isn't it better to push humanity to stand on its own early? Char is a man who thinks seriously about the evolution of humankind.

br_p7b_04.adi.en: We joined Neo Zeon because you're with us, Captain. There's no other reason. We just follow you.
br_p7b_04.adi.note: Japanese says 'because Captain Kamuna is here' (respectful third person, addressed to him); rendered as direct address.

history.old: We joined Neo Zeon because you're with us, Captain. There's no other reason. We just follow you.
history.reason: Taichou to Kamuna = 'Commander'.

br_p7b_05.adi.note: Low-confidence 0.37 s grunt; likely Kamuna's habitual 'un' (mm). Could also be a pained 'ugh'.

br_p7b_06.adi.en: Our unit will take on the core of the enemy force: Londo Bell's Jegan squadrons.

br_p7b_07.adi.en: The Federation still has the numbers, as usual, but our mobile suits and pilots are top quality. We should be able to fight them evenly or better.

br_p7b_08.adi.en: I've lost count of how many times I've said this, but your lives are in my hands. I'm counting on you.

br_p8a_01.adi.en: Now, let me quickly explain the operation.

br_p8a_02.adi.en: For the past several days, unidentified mobile suits had been sighted at the resource base in Frontier Side. On those reports, the Federation Forces deployed mobile suits to be ready for an emergency, but yesterday it finally happened: a mobile suit sent out on recon was destroyed.

history.old: For the past several days, unidentified mobile suits had been sighted at the resource base in Frontier Side. On those reports, the Federation Forces deployed mobile suits to be ready for an emergency, but yesterday it finally happened: a mobile suit sent out on recon was destroyed.
history.reason: Spoken briefing: present perfect for an ongoing situation; 'On those reports' -> 'In response'.

br_p8a_03.adi.en: So that's why we got sent here. And then?

br_p8a_04.adi.en: The unknown enemy may have caught on to that. They're expected to send in a force bigger than anything so far. It looks like they mean to take this base.

br_p8a_05.adi.en: I hear that, although you're short on combat experience, you were pilots of unmatched talent at the officers' academy. Please protect this base from the mysterious mobile suit forces. I'm counting on you. The enemy will probably enter our air-defense zone in about 10 minutes.

br_p8a_06.adi.en: All right, just leave it to me. Can't speak for this one here, but you can count on me.

br_p8b_01.adi.en: Now, let's go over the operation orders.

br_p8b_02.adi.en: We of the Crossbone Vanguard have kept training for the uprising coming next year. Pilots and new mobile suits alike are now expected to be fit for real combat.

br_p8b_03.adi.en: So, an operation has been drawn up to raid an Earth Federation resource base - to test our newest units, put our pilots through a live-combat trial, and secure resources.

br_p8b_05.adi.en: You've been recognized as especially outstanding among the trainees, and you've been assigned to pilot mobile suits and wipe out the enemy defenses. The enemy units deployed there are all outdated models, not much of a force. You should be fine. Now, begin sortie preparations at once.

br_p8b_06.adi.en: Sir! Aegis Veracruz, mission understood! I'm itching to go. Real combat at last!

br_p9a_02.adi.en: The Crossbone Vanguard has begun its full-scale operation to seize Frontier Side. We of the garrison force must work with the resistance to stop it.

br_p9a_03.adi.en: Stop them? They outnumber us way too much!

br_p9a_04.adi.en: True. The Federation brass on Earth aren't taking this very seriously, and I have to admit our odds are slim.

br_p9a_05.adi.en: However, the Federation has seriously begun developing high-performance small mobile suits. In fact, we have the F91 and a few Heavyguns deployed right here. We can't just hand Frontier over without a fight.
br_p9a_05.adi.note: 'F-91' read as the Gundam F91 (one unit); 'shousuu nagara' applied to the deployment as a whole.

br_p9a_06.adi.en: Well, I know that. We don't plan on losing to the Crossbone Vanguard that easily either. Yeah... let's do what we can.

br_p9b_01.adi.en: The operation to seize Frontier Side now enters its main phase. We'll destroy every Federation unit that comes out to intercept us outside the colonies and completely neutralize enemy resistance.

br_p9b_02.adi.en: They don't have much of a force, right? Sounds like a cakewalk.

br_p9b_03.adi.en: There's a report that Captain Zabine's advance unit engaged a new model, and took heavy damage at that. We can't afford to be careless.
br_p9b_03.adi.note: Misheard taiin -> taii (same pattern as Amuro/Quattro in this slice); see uncertain.

br_p9b_04.adi.en: It's unconfirmed, but there's also word that Lady Berah Ronah's Vigna-Ghina still hasn't returned to the ship.

br_p9b_05.adi.en: So if you find Lady Berah, please escort her back to the ship. That's part of the mission too.

br_p9b_06.adi.en: Got it. Let's head out, then!
