d_002.adi.en: You hit me twice! Not even my father ever hit me!

d_003.adi.en: I... I can pilot the Gundam better than anyone! Better than anyone!

d_004.adi.en: I want to beat that man.
d_004.adi.note: 'Ano hito' = Ramba Ral in the source scene; 'man' is safe.

d_005.adi.en: It's frustrating, but I guess I'm a man after all.

d_006.adi.en: I'm sorry. I still have a place I can go back to. Nothing could make me happier. You understand, don't you? I can go see Lalah anytime.

d_007.adi.en: Damn it! I can't even slow the enemy down!
d_007.adi.note: ASR 'nante tochi de' read as 'nante kotta' (best reading).

d_008.adi.en: Maybe I really am a weakling.
d_008.adi.note: Echoes Sayla calling Kai a weakling (nanjakumono).

d_009.adi.en: Miharu, I won't grieve anymore. So there won't be more kids like you, I'm going to smash Zeon. All the way.

d_010.adi.en: Is that Sleggar? Too fast! He's too fast!
d_010.adi.note: Read as in v05 evc039 (same line in mission: Sleggar rushing ahead).

d_011.adi.en: You're so vague. Smart people like you always are, Sayla.

d_012.adi.en: Guess that's true. People can't become God, even if they stand on their heads.

d_013.adi.en: At times like this, it's best to be a coward.

d_013_kai_fg.adi.en: At times like this, it's best to be a coward.

d_014.adi.en: This is so frustrating. If I'm the only one like this, I'll never match Sayla or Kai... It's p-pathetic.

d_015.adi.en: Kai's doing it by himself, isn't he? I can do it.
d_015.adi.note: Hayato insisting he can pilot alone, like Kai.

d_016.adi.en: I can't leave everything to Kai!
d_016.adi.note: ASR 'kaisan' (dissolution) = Kai-san; same wording as v05 evc053.

d_018.adi.en: Hmm... You've got the look of someone troubled over a man. Ha! So, where's my bunk?
d_018.adi.note: Sleggar to Mirai (coded hyt_fg, but content is Sleggar).

d_019.adi.en: It's sad, but this is war.
d_019.adi.note: Sleggar; same wording as v05 evc044.

d_020.adi.en: Sticking to a lady's backside just isn't my style.

d_021.adi.en: This person means it. Get it?
d_021.adi.note: Referent of 'kono hito' unknown; kept neutral.

d_022.adi.en: Ensign, you're too dazzling for a guy like me. We live in different worlds.

d_023.adi.en: That's what being spoiled is! Who ever grew up without getting hit?!

history.old: That's being spoiled! Where's anyone who grew up without ever getting hit?
history.reason: 'Where's anyone who grew up...' was awkward; familiar rhetorical shape of Bright's line.

d_024.adi.en: Even I'd like to live as smoothly as everyone else, at least while I'm alive... but I'm too clumsy for that.

d_027.adi.en: What are you saying?! How dare a man scheming for a Zabi dictatorship say that!
d_027.adi.note: Uncoded; aimed at a man (otoko) plotting Zabi rule, likely Gihren.

d_028.adi.en: I'd rather not admit it... the mistakes of my own youth.

d_029.adi.note: Char's answer about Garma's death; 'he' = Garma.

d_030.adi.en: You were a good friend, but your father is to blame.

d_031.adi.en: Now, show me what the Federation's mobile suit can do.

d_032.adi.en: I'll show you that the difference in mobile suit performance isn't what decides a battle!

history.old: I'll show you that mobile suit performance isn't the deciding factor in battle!
history.reason: Restored 'difference in' performance, dropped from the iconic line.

d_032_chr_fg.adi.en: I'll show you that the difference in mobile suit performance isn't what decides a battle!

history.old: I'll show you that mobile suit performance isn't the deciding factor in battle!
history.reason: Same audio as d_032.

d_033.adi.en: Is the Federation's mobile suit a monster?!

d_034.adi.en: Even in a mobile suit, it's my principle to always come back.

d_035.adi.en: Lalah! Stop talking nonsense with him!

history.old: Lalah! Stop your foolishness with him!
history.reason: The source word is idle or nonsense talk (Lalah's exchange with Amuro), not foolish behaviour.

d_036.adi.en: As I am now, I cannot defeat the Gundam. Lalah, guide me.
d_036.adi.note: ASR 'taosenara' read as 'taosen. Lalah,' (the known line).

d_037.adi.en: Make the most of every chance. That is my principle.

d_038.adi.en: Become a fine woman. Amuro is calling.

d_039.adi.en: You understand why I wear the mask, don't you? I have cast away my past.

d_040.adi.en: Garma, this is my offering to you. Live happily with your sister.
d_040.adi.note: Char after killing Kycilia; 'tamuke' = offering to the dead.

d_041.adi.en: I'd been looking forward to him becoming a great general, one who could make good use of even me.

d_042.adi.en: War is a numbers game, brother!

d_043.adi.en: Over a trifle like this, we'll be the laughingstock of the whole nation!

d_044.adi.en: I am a soldier. A soldier who will build the Zabi family's tradition. I will not die!
d_044.adi.note: ASR 'shini wasure' read as 'shini wa sen' (best reading).

d_044_dzl_fg.adi.en: I am a soldier. A soldier who will build the Zabi family's tradition. I will not die!

d_046.adi.en: I'll say it outright: they are trash!

d_047.adi.en: Citizens! Turn your sorrow into anger! Rise up, citizens!

d_048.adi.en: Our forces are overwhelming, are they not?

d_050.adi.en: The crime of patricide cannot be escaped, even by the Supreme Commander. Anyone who objects may take it to court when this battle is over.
d_050.adi.note: Kycilia; sousui = Supreme Commander per glossary.

d_051.adi.en: So even the Red Comet has fallen to earth.

d_052.adi.en: I won't let Side 2 happen again!

d_053.adi.en: Whether we live or die, we'll do it together!

d_054.adi.en: Pilots have their own way of fighting.

d_055.adi.en: Right! As team leader, I'm giving the order! 08th MS Team, move out!

history.old: Right! As team leader, I'm giving the order! 08th Team, move out!
history.reason: Glossary: 08 shoutai = '08th MS Team'.

d_056.adi.en: Not for the Federation! But for my comrades, I can fight!

d_057.adi.en: I'll live! And spend my life with Aina!

d_058.adi.en: So much for 'coming back alive'! So much for 'I can fight for my comrades'! I'm scared!

d_059.adi.en: Thanks. But come on, spare me the GM head. Anything but a GM.
d_059.adi.note: Karen's Ground Type was refitted with a GM head.

history.old: Thanks. But come on, spare me the GM head. Not a GM.
history.reason: Bare fragment 'Not a GM.' read as a statement; made the protest clear.

d_060.adi.en: Heh. Now this is starting to feel like a real fight.

history.old: Heh. Now this is starting to feel like the real thing.
history.reason: Same line as in-mission evc111_krn_08; reuse that wording.

d_061.adi.en: An idiot who's quit worrying sure is tough.

d_062.adi.en: Men... every last one of them goes and leaves me behind!

d_063.adi.en: What, she's a dyed-in-the-wool softie too? Don't take the military lightly!

d_064.adi.en: Then don't say it at all!

d_065.adi.en: This team might just change my luck.

d_066.adi.en: I'm... I'm not a grim reaper.

d_067.adi.en: Our BB, who art in heaven!
d_067.adi.note: Lord's Prayer parody; BB is Michel's girlfriend (v05 evc077), so the speaker may be Michel despite the tsj_08 code.

d_068.adi.note: ASR 'taichou (health)' = taichou; Shiro is 'Lieutenant' to his team (v05).

d_069.adi.en: Is there anyone who hates beautiful things?
d_069.adi.note: Read as Aina's known line (coded tsj_08).

d_070.adi.en: Get away! Do you want to die?!

d_070_ain_08.adi.en: Get away! Do you want to die?!

d_071.adi.en: Pride, honor, order... a daughter of the Sakhalin family... I'm just like a doll.

d_072.adi.en: If only we two were the last man and woman left in this world.

d_075.adi.en: You wrong me. I'm not made of wood, you know.
d_075.adi.note: Idiom 'not born from the fork of a tree' = not without feelings; tree imagery kept as 'made of wood'.

d_076.adi.en: Hmph! Abandoning the base! That proves incompetence as a soldier!

d_077.adi.en: Your good eyes will kill you!

d_077_nrs_08.adi.en: Your good eyes will kill you!

d_078.adi.en: It's so fast it's almost frightening. Can a machine this sensitive work in real combat?

d_079.adi.en: If we hadn't fought, many more people would have died. It couldn't be helped.

d_080.adi.en: If you fight, people die because of it. But even if you don't, they still die. There's no right thing to do, anywhere. I just have to do what I can.

history.old: If you fight, people die because of it. But even if you don't, they still die. Nothing is right anywhere. All I can do is what I'm able to.
history.reason: 'Nothing is right anywhere' and 'what I'm able to' were stiff; same meaning.

d_081.adi.en: Phew. All the way out here, and I'm stuck dealing with a kid.

d_081_ber_80.adi.en: Phew. All the way out here, and I'm stuck dealing with a kid.

d_082.adi.en: Born and raised in Sydney. I bet the city's all white with snow right now.

d_083.adi.en: I found myself wanting to fight it... the Gundam.

d_084.adi.en: Sorry, Bernie. One more kill and you'd have been an ace.

d_085.adi.en: For those who are about to perish.

d_085_mih_80.adi.en: For those who are about to perish.

d_086.adi.en: Come on! I'll teach you how to fight!
d_086.adi.note: Misha; same wording as v05 evc134.

d_087.adi.en: Even so, I'm a Federation officer!

d_089.adi.en: We're almost through the first line!

d_091.adi.en: It's passed the point of no return...

history.old: It's crossed the interception limit point...
history.reason: 'Interception limit point' was opaque; briefing br_c16_01 renders the same 0083 term as 'point of no return'.

d_093.adi.en: All right, don't go drawing your pay for nothing!

d_093_bng_83.adi.en: All right, don't go drawing your pay for nothing!

d_094.adi.en: Times like that, you take cover.

d_095.adi.en: Ah... so I'm an old-timer now too, huh?

d_096.adi.en: The military won't pay you, you know.

d_097.adi.en: That help came at a high price. This is the end. Withdrawing from the combat zone.

d_098.adi.en: Hey, Scott... why don't you think about something else for once? Something like this.

d_099.adi.en: The colony is bound for Earth.
d_099.adi.note: Uncoded; verbless source line, speaker unknown (Delaz Fleet side).

history.old: The colony goes to Earth.
history.reason: 'The colony goes to Earth' read oddly; verb restored without inventing an action.

d_100.adi.en: Hm? Has Cima botched it? Buy time until the Solar System fires!

d_101.adi.en: Oh, I can see the colony with my own eyes. Enough! Fire! I don't care! Do it!

d_102.adi.en: How often I sortied from here, eluding the Federation's eyes.

d_102_gat_83.adi.en: How often I sortied from here, eluding the Federation's eyes.

d_103.adi.en: Tch! If we dawdle, it'll endanger the great cause!

d_104.adi.en: And yet how feeble. Swept aside at the first touch, as they say.

d_105.adi.en: Magnificent. It's as if the spirit of Zeon has taken form.

d_105_gat_83.adi.en: Magnificent. It's as if the spirit of Zeon has taken form.

d_106.adi.en: Perhaps you are the true witness to Stardust.

d_108.adi.en: Still, who'd have thought they'd hit the soft underbelly?
d_108.adi.note: Whose flank is not settled by the line; kept impersonal.

d_109.adi.en: Get dragged off to a backwater like Axis, and business is ruined!

d_110.adi.en: Just whose side are you on?!

d_111.adi.en: Grit your teeth! I'll correct an adult like you!

d_111_kam_zg.adi.en: Grit your teeth! I'll correct an adult like you!

d_112.adi.en: What's wrong with Kamille being a man's name?! I'm a man!

history.old: What's wrong with a guy named Kamille?! I'm a man!
history.reason: The source asks what is wrong with Kamille being a man's name; restored that.

d_113.adi.en: Looks like killing people is all I'm good for.

d_114.adi.en: You bastard! People died! So many people died!

d_115.adi.en: Ah... a big star, flickering on and off... Haha, is it a big comet? No, that's not it. Comets go more like... whoosh.

d_116.adi.en: I am Captain Quattro Bajeena now. Nothing more, nothing less.
d_116.adi.note: ASR 'taii' as 'taii (doctor)'; rank Captain per glossary.

d_118.adi.en: It means people have hearts that can feel shame.

d_120.adi.en: Lalah's soul drifts in the Earth Sphere. I didn't think she'd be out beyond Mars.

d_121.adi.en: How dare you raise Mineva like this! What do you hope to gain raising someone who's nothing but prejudice?

d_122.adi.en: Recreation is fine, but a boy's face weighed down with odd worries isn't a good look.

d_123.adi.en: Personally, I take more pride in the name 'Rick Dias'.
d_123.adi.note: Quattro preferring the name Rick Dias (over Gamma Gundam); 'the name' added from that context.

d_125.adi.en: Huh? Can this thing actually fly?

d_126.adi.en: Don't be an adult or a child just when it suits you!

d_127.adi.en: You were too much of a woman.

d_128.adi.en: Men really perk up and get sharp once there's a war, don't they?

d_129.adi.en: Oh my! 'A marriage proposal coming soon'? Honestly...

d_130.adi.en: I'm not thinking about marriage, thank you.

d_133.adi.en: Kamille... take my life... take my life, and win!

history.old: A second Amuro.
history.reason: Matches in-mission evc240_brt_zg's rendering of the same phrase.

d_135.adi.en: You breed resentment, and then you say that?

d_136.adi.en: I've gone and become a captain who loses his ship again.

d_137.adi.en: That's the Zabi family, all right. Does time just not move for these people?

d_138.adi.en: Port side! Gunners! The barrage is too thin! What are you doing?!

d_139.adi.en: Search team, where were you looking?

d_140.adi.en: Lieutenant, care to join me for tea?

d_141.adi.en: But you know... if it left you unable to have babies...
d_141.adi.note: Trails off as in the source.

d_142.adi.en: As long as the Lieutenant's safe. Use the Radish as a shield!

d_143.adi.en: Hey, Kamille. If you go down to Earth, bring me back a souvenir.

d_144.adi.en: I fought enough in the One Year War.

d_146.adi.en: I'm pretty sure I said 'Char' just now.
d_146.adi.note: Context not certain; kept close to the words.

d_147.adi.en: It's a dig at me. Char and Hayato both let some kid use the Gundam and just ignore me...

d_148.adi.en: Ignore people's kindness and you'll suffer for life! Kamille!

d_149.adi.en: Captain Quattro, I'd rather you didn't underestimate Karaba.

d_150.adi.en: Even if it takes 10 or 20 years, you should become the Federation's Prime Minister.

d_151.adi.en: Surely you could admit it by now?

d_152.adi.en: As long as they're alive, that's enough. Will you tell them that?

d_154.adi.en: What a scary person. That glare... someone who can't live in any world but war, don't you think?
d_154.adi.note: Who is described is not settled: no pronoun.

d_155.adi.en: Just as I'm afraid of the sky falling, this person is afraid of fighting.

d_156.adi.en: I'll be frank. You need to give the Mk-II to Amuro.

d_157.adi.en: To think I'm stuck babysitting brats like you.

d_158.adi.en: These hands. Can hands like these, still untouched by filth, really kill anyone?

d_159.adi.en: Someday I want the Titans in my hands too. For that, I have to swallow my pride and learn.

d_160.adi.en: I've become a man who can't take a single step forward until I beat Kamille. He's a wall to me.

d_161.adi.en: I haven't killed as many as you!

d_164.adi.en: Hey, will you do something for me? Kiss me.

d_166.adi.en: Kamille, can I ask you again? Do you like your name?

d_167.adi.en: Playing a hidden role is a difficult thing.

d_167_pap_zg.adi.en: Playing a hidden role is a difficult thing.

d_168.adi.en: I believe it is women who will rule the Earth after the war.

d_169.adi.en: Sarah... what a sweet thing you are.

d_170.adi.en: I think I could come to like that woman.

d_171.adi.en: This warmth is what you have been searching for.

d_172.adi.en: Sarah may forgive you, but I will not forg-
d_172.adi.note: Cut off as in the source.

d_173.adi.en: You Spacenoids should've just stayed up in the sky!

d_173_bur_zg.adi.en: You Spacenoids should've just stayed up in the sky!

d_174.adi.en: You stand before Lady Mineva. No more insolence!

d_175.adi.en: So people can understand each other?

history.old: People can understand each other, right?
history.reason: Same line as in-mission evc463_ham_zg (Haman's retort); reuse that wording.

d_176.adi.en: Leina, just you wait. With this, I'll get you into an uptown school.

d_177.adi.en: You don't know why we're struggling, not at all, not one bit! That's why grown-ups are so hopeless!

d_179.adi.en: Wow, what a storm of emotion! The ZZ has incredible power!

d_180.adi.en: I found something amazing. A Zaku! A real MS-06F! It's barely even damaged.

d_181.adi.en: Nobody can fight a war sane!

d_183.adi.en: We get to see a Newtype showdown!

d_184.adi.en: Fa, if you're that uptight, no guy's ever going to look your way.

d_185.adi.en: They say it's cute when a cool woman messes up.

d_187.adi.en: I did it! Amazing! I could fall in love with myself!

d_188.adi.en: I'll show you what a difference the ZZ's power makes!

history.old: I'll show you the difference in the ZZ's power!
history.reason: 'The difference in the ZZ's power' was awkward; keeps 'difference' as in evc622_rlk_zz.

d_189.adi.en: Listen. People in the old days died for far more senseless reasons. If it frustrates you, why not get your will to fight back?

d_190.adi.en: You're not the real thing. Getting distracted by a fight in the middle of hitting on a woman. That's exactly what gets on my nerves most.

d_192.adi.en: When the big brother's a slob, the little sister has it rough, huh?

d_194.adi.en: Why should we kids have to fight and clean up after a war the grown-ups started on their own?!

d_195.adi.en: Hey, this is real gravity! We're falling! Earth is one ridiculously huge water drop!

d_196.adi.en: Captain Bright, let me say it next! Nahel Argama, launch!

d_197.adi.en: Think you can finish us off any time, huh? Making fools of us! Fine, I'll smash 'em, colony and all!

d_200.adi.en: Well, it's not that we don't want to sortie. We just can't find a reason to fight, that's all.

d_201.adi.en: Wow! Nothing but the latest machinery! This'll sell for a fortune!

d_202.adi.en: Isn't saving Leina reason enough? Judau and Leina are our friends, aren't they?

d_203.adi.en: Shut up, you nagging old hag!

d_205.adi.en: The Captain's lived alone a long time.

d_207.adi.en: Stop fussing like an old uncle.

d_208.adi.en: Thank you, Captain Bright, and everyone on the Argama.

d_209.adi.en: We'll be together... we won't... we will... we won't... we will... Captain Bright!
d_209.adi.note: Petal-plucking fortune (loves me, loves me not); probably Emary.

d_210.adi.en: Don't worry about it. Just think of it as an expensive lesson.

d_210_ham_zz.adi.en: Don't worry about it. Just think of it as an expensive lesson.

d_211.adi.en: With you, I end up speaking my true feelings so freely. How strange.

d_212.adi.en: I hate that clingy stuff. Save the rest for heaven or something.

d_213.adi.en: To put this much pressure on me... Judau Ashta is far too dangerous.

d_214.adi.en: As if battles ever go by the textbook!

d_216.adi.en: My heart's all fluttery... but it feels really good. What's happening to me?

d_217.adi.en: I'm Elpeo Ple! Nice to meet you!

d_217_ple_zz.adi.en: I'm Elpeo Ple! Nice to meet you!

d_218.adi.en: This enemy makes me all prickly! I hate it!

d_218_ple_zz.adi.en: This enemy makes me all prickly! I hate it!

d_219.adi.en: Ah, this feeling... Ah, what is this feeling, this grating...
d_219.adi.note: Trails off as in the source.

d_219_plt_zz.adi.en: Ah, this feeling... Ah, what is this feeling, this grating...

d_221.adi.en: What a nice breeze. It feels good on my flushed body.

d_222.adi.en: A lion gives its all to bring down even a rabbit, so it can live. I, too, swear by this rose...
d_222.adi.note: Trails off as in the source.

d_223.adi.en: By the rose on my breast, I will defeat you! Prepare yourself, Zeta!

d_224.adi.en: Fate will surely bring Lady Haman a glorious victory! Evil will be repaid with evil, and sin with sin!
d_224.adi.note: Same wording as his briefing line in an earlier slice.

d_225.adi.en: How?! There's a kid piloting that thing!

history.old: Why?! There's a child aboard that thing!
history.reason: Same line as in-mission evc655_rkn_zz; reuse that wording.

d_228.adi.en: Such a quick change of heart.

d_230.adi.en: Is that light an Argama mobile suit? Perhaps Miss Roux Louka is aboard it after all.

history.old: Is that light an Argama mobile suit? Surely Miss Roux Louka is aboard it.
history.reason: The source is a tentative guess ('I wonder... after all'); 'Surely' overstated it.

d_231.adi.en: Allow me to repay you for that time. Mama always told me to settle my debts properly.

d_231_glt_zz.adi.en: Allow me to repay you for that time. Mama always told me to settle my debts properly.

d_232.adi.en: Heh heh, I've finally caught you. What is this pounding in my chest? Mama, could this be what they call love?

d_233.adi.en: This would suit Roux Louka. But I don't know her measurements.

d_234.adi.en: You seem to be kind to any woman at all, Judau.

d_235.adi.en: A-all right, Roux, have it your way. If it's you who defeats me, I have no regrets. Come, Roux...

d_236.adi.en: Let it be as Venus wills. Then she shall bring Mars to us.

d_237.adi.en: I am a man who could easily rule Neo Zeon.

d_237_glt_zz.adi.en: I am a man who could easily rule Neo Zeon.

d_238.adi.en: If you call it tainted blood, I will humbly accept those words. But when next we meet, I'll take your head cleanly and rebuild Zeon's kingdom of blood with my own hands.

d_239.adi.note: Same wording as the earlier slice.

d_241.adi.en: Damn, I've started having that same dream again.

d_241_amr_cc.adi.en: Damn, I've started having that same dream again.

d_243.adi.en: We have to stop Axis no matter what!

d_245.adi.en: All right! Now I can crush Char all on my own!

d_246.adi.en: Oh, Astonaige, the things you say!

d_249.adi.en: When Londo Bell goes in to investigate, the locals just clam up.

d_251.adi.en: What are you doing?! The Jegan squad!

d_252.adi.en: Ready the dummy missiles! First missile wave, fire!

d_253.adi.en: Use the anti-missile particle shells sparingly!

d_254.adi.en: If you come out to fight too, what happens to your mother and Cheimin?
d_254.adi.note: Bright to Hathaway; Cheimin Noa is his daughter.

d_255.adi.en: Could that light be... the Psycho-Frame light Chan was talking about?

d_256.adi.en: Amuro, I'm doing something ruthless. If you're close by, then try to sense me.

d_257.adi.en: Unlike you, I can't afford to be just a pilot.

d_258.adi.en: Those who remain on Earth are people whose souls are bound by gravity, doing nothing but polluting it.

d_259.adi.en: And then I shall be called to the side of my father, Zeon.

d_260.adi.en: There were nukes among the missiles. Well done, Londo Bell.

d_261.adi.en: Only one nuclear missile among these as well. Well done, Bright.

d_262.adi.en: Is there any meaning in beating a pathetic mobile suit? ...And yet, this is nonsense.

d_262_chr_cc.adi.en: Is there any meaning in beating a pathetic mobile suit? ...And yet, this is nonsense.

d_263.adi.en: Wow, they made CG straight from the footage of the last battle!

d_264.adi.en: Oh, so that's Amuro Ray. Over heeere!

d_265.adi.en: Amuro, that's kind of cheap of you.

d_266.adi.en: There's a nasty woman on the Ra Cailum.

d_267.adi.en: Why... do I feel... so sick...

d_267_qes_cc.adi.en: Why... do I feel... so sick...

d_269.adi.note: Sustained 'gyuu' sound; Whisper repeated it. Rendered as a strain cry.

d_270.adi.en: I hate kids! They're so pushy!

d_271.adi.en: Give me a break! I already get grief for coming from the Newtype Lab as it is.

d_271_gyn_cc.adi.en: Give me a break! I already get grief for coming from the Newtype Lab as it is.

d_272.adi.en: He's just using war to vent his frustrations. When someone like the Colonel snaps, he goes and smashes colonies.
d_272.adi.note: Subject of the first sentence inferred as Char from the second.

history.old: He's just taking his frustrations out on war. When someone like the Colonel snaps, he goes and smashes colonies.
history.reason: 'Taking his frustrations out on war' made war the target; the source means war is his outlet.

d_274.adi.en: Nobody has to tell me. I won't let the Colonel have Quess.

d_275.adi.en: Go, funnels! The missile giving off the most heat! Hit it!

d_276.adi.en: What's this pressure from the upper left? The Gundam?!

d_277.adi.en: No doubt about it! That's the Gundam! Take that down, and Colonel, Supreme Commander, whoever...!

d_278.adi.en: Amuro Ray is a man who mistakes kindness for a Newtype's weapon. A woman could forgive a man like that, but the Colonel cannot forgive such an Amuro.
d_278.adi.note: Nanai's line despite the rzn code.

d_279.adi.en: So love has turned into hatred a hundredfold?

d_281.adi.en: You wear yourself out because you wish to be Char Aznable... no, Casval Deikun.

d_282.adi.en: Ah... the Colonel... the Colonel's life is being drained away...

d_283.adi.en: Some strategy! Mobile suits are supposed to be about close combat!

d_284.adi.en: Not bad, darting around like that.

d_284_rzn_cc.adi.en: Not bad, darting around like that.

d_286.adi.en: Hmph! Londo Bell should just stick to ringing their bells!

d_287.adi.en: What is this power? I'm taking a direct hit!

d_289.adi.en: Like hell we're getting killed for grown-ups' convenience!
d_289.adi.note: Subject read as 'we' (Seabook leading the kids); the clip does not settle I/we.

d_290.adi.en: This mobile suit... Mom worked on it.

d_291.adi.en: You seem like you're in a hurry to die.

d_292.adi.en: I wonder if this bio-sensor is in sync with my biorhythm.
d_292.adi.note: Transcript says bio-sensor (F91 has a bio-computer); kept as heard.

d_293.adi.en: So being big and eating army food makes you better, huh?

d_294.adi.en: This happened because I wore Mama's dress.

d_294_ccl_91.adi.en: This happened because I wore Mama's dress.

d_295.adi.en: This thing Mother left me... it sounds like it's ringing.

d_295_ccl_91.adi.en: This thing Mother left me... it sounds like it's ringing.

d_297.adi.en: There used to be a mobile suit with a face like this. Let's code-name it Gundam F91.

d_298.adi.en: To escape, you've got to use anything.

d_299.adi.en: All of you holding your ground here are far more battle-ready than soldiers who only draw a paycheck.

d_300.adi.en: Come on! I'm going down below!

d_301.adi.en: If you don't want your sister killed and thrown out into cold space, then pilot!

d_303.adi.en: They say a Newtype can see things as they are and grasp their true nature. I'm starting to want to believe it.

d_304.adi.en: A new Federation model? Could be. This is what comes of the old man obsessing over Berah Ronah.

d_305.adi.en: The thousand-year dream of the Ronah family: to let humanity survive for all eternity.

d_305_kzo_91.adi.en: The thousand-year dream of the Ronah family: to let humanity survive for all eternity.

d_306.adi.en: The Ronah family must have come to need you. I'm only carrying out Grandfather's orders.

d_307.adi.en: Don't let even a single mobile suit escape! Every one of you, win yourselves glory!

d_308.adi.en: I'm still Kincade Nau, after all. I have to go.

d_309.adi.en: I'm human! Being human is enough for me!

d_309_tva_cb.adi.en: I'm human! Being human is enough for me!

d_310.adi.en: You're dead, remember? A dead man can't go showing up like this.

evc001_chr_fg.adi.en: No one has ever attacked at a moment like this before. Now, how will you respond, Trojan Horse?
evc001_chr_fg.adi.note: 'Mokuba' (Trojan Horse) = Zeon nickname for White Base.

evc002_amr_fg.adi.en: Damn you, Char! If it's a mobile suit, there's no person in it! I'll do it!
evc002_amr_fg.adi.note: 'Shaa-men' read as 'Shaa-me' (damn you, Char). Lit. 'if the opponent is a mobile suit, it isn't a human.'

history.old: Damn you, Char! If it's a mobile suit, there's no person in it! I'll do it!
history.reason: 'there's no person in it' implied unmanned; Amuro is telling himself the enemy is a machine, not a person.

evc004_chr_fg.adi.en: He doesn't know the first thing about fighting. An amateur.

evc006_chr_fg.adi.en: So tough! Damn the Federation, what a mobile suit they've built!

evc007_brt_fg.adi.en: Ngh, the barrage is too thin! What are you doing?!

evc008_chr_fg.adi.en: As expected of a new battleship. It's nothing like the ones before.

history.old: As expected of a new battleship. It's nothing like the ones before.
history.reason: 'As expected of' is translationese; Char's composed voice.

evc010_chr_fg.adi.en: A Zaku in one shot... Does that thing have a beam weapon as strong as a battleship's main gun?

evc011_brt_fg.adi.en: Amuro! Come back now! We're out of time!

evc012_amr_fg.adi.en: How can I turn my back on the enemy mid-fight?!

evc014_amr_fg.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR; same reading as evc002.

evc015_brt_fg.adi.en: Amuro! Get back here! There's no time!

evc017_dre_fg.adi.note: Dren. 'Gobun wo' (five minutes) read as 'gobuun wo' (good luck); it plays at the start of the stage.

evc019_sl1_ze.adi.note: Zeon soldier. Low-confidence ASR; 'nante soko da' read as 'nande soko ni' (surprise at enemy's position).

evc020_dre_fg.adi.en: Major, we don't have much time left.

evc023_chr_fg.adi.en: Ngh, I didn't make it in time...

evc024_chr_fg.adi.en: Don't go too low. The atmosphere will pull you in.

evc025_chr_fg.adi.en: Uwaaagh! Is the Federation's mobile suit a monster?!

evc026_amr_fg.adi.en: I did it! I beat Char!

evc027_dre_fg.adi.en: Major, time's up. Please return safely.

evc029_chr_fg.adi.en: Heh heh heh... With this, the Trojan Horse falls into Zeon territory. War is merciless. One must read two or three moves ahead.

evc510_kam_zg.adi.en: A man blind to the reality before his eyes...

evc511_pap_zg.adi.en: What would a child who's merely clever know!

evc514_pap_zg.adi.en: Don't think you can win, boy!

evc515_kam_zg.adi.note: 'Koitsu dake wa' elides the verb; restored from the opening 'yurusenai'.

evc547_pap_zg.adi.en: Curse yourself for rotting away in a place like this!

evc549_ham_zg.adi.en: If you have any intention of returning to my side...

evc552_pap_zg.adi.en: A failed Newtype like you is destined to be purged! Do you understand?!

evc554_pap_zg.adi.en: That woman means to bury Char herself? Interesting, I'll give her that.

evc557_qua_zg.adi.en: No... There's one more actor here.

evc560_pap_zg.adi.en: I'm merely a witness to history, so I suppose it may look that way.

history.old: Even if I don't lift a hand, humanity will change as it awakens as Newtypes. I'll wait for that time.

evc571_qua_zg.adi.en: Don't you see you'll just repeat the same mistakes?

evc572_ham_zg.adi.en: A man who can't see what the world truly needs should be eliminated.

evc593_qua_zg.adi.en: Is that your decision to make?

evc748_glt_zz.adi.en: That's right. He's the enemy you must defeat.

evc749_rlk_zz.adi.en: I won't forget that you said you loved me.

evc771_jud_zz.adi.en: Your very existence gets on my nerves!

evc793_jud_zz.adi.en: Stop thinking only with your own head!

evc805_ham_zz.adi.en: ...is proof that humans are still pulled by Earth's gravity and can't fly free.

evc806_jud_zz.adi.en: Even so, fighting in a place like this won't do anything...

evc807_ham_zz.adi.en: That's right. Thanks to you clever brats, I couldn't wipe out the fools clinging to the Earth. It's all because you children...

evc813_ham_zz.adi.en: You came alone, Judau. That's the child I saw promise in.

evc815_ham_zz.adi.en: What's wrong? That's not all you've got, is it?

evc817_amr_cc.adi.en: We're clearly short on forces... Damn you, Char.

evc818_sl1_ro.adi.en: Yes, sir. Fifth Luna has accelerated toward Earth.

evc819_amr_cc.adi.en: Damn! They've ignited it?! A force thrown together at the last minute was never enough!

evc822_amr_cc.adi.en: And we couldn't stop Fifth Luna falling to Earth...

evc826_amr_cc.adi.en: Why drop something like this on Earth?! It'll grow so cold no one can live there! A nuclear winter's coming!

evc827_chr_cc.adi.en: The people on Earth think only of themselves. That's why I declared I would wipe them out.

evc829_chr_cc.adi.en: I, Char Aznable, intend to purge them, Amuro.

evc831_amr_cc.adi.en: The Earth can't hold out any longer!
evc831_amr_cc.adi.note: Char's line in the CCA film (answering Amuro's 'That's just ego'); clip code is amr. Translated as written; speaker not verifiable from text.

evc832_chr_cc.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR, clip cut short; read as 'sonna mono ka'.

evc833_gyn_cc.adi.en: Colonel, why aren't you using your funnels?

evc834_gyn_cc.adi.en: Any more hits and I'll be wrecked!
evc834_gyn_cc.adi.note: ASR taika (degenerate) = taiha (wrecked). Subject taken as Gyunei himself: Char's reply orders Gyunei back because his damage is visible from outside.

evc835_chr_cc.adi.en: Gyunei, fall back. You can't go on like that. I can see it from out here.

evc837_chr_cc.adi.en: You'll never beat me in such a pathetic mobile suit.

evc838_amr_cc.adi.en: Damn, he's so calm... So this isn't over yet?

history.old: This presence... Amuro's here.
history.reason: 'iru na, Amuro' is Char addressing Amuro (vocative), not a third-person remark

history.old: This situation's against me.
history.reason: 'This situation's against me' is stiff; natural spoken phrasing, same meaning

evc842_gyn_cc.adi.note: Gyunei insisting he can continue alone; Char refuses next row.

evc843_chr_cc.adi.en: You can't. It's obvious from out here. You did well guarding Fifth Luna's nuclear nozzles.

history.old: You can't. It's obvious from out here. You did well guarding Fifth Luna's nuclear nozzles.
history.reason: same Char phrase as evc835 ('I can see it from out here'); use one wording

evc845_qes_cc.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR; Quess playing with her funnels.

evc847_qes_cc.adi.en: Don't you have stuff to do yourself?
evc847_qes_cc.adi.note: Read as Quess snapping back at Gyunei (addressee inferred).

evc848_amr_cc.adi.en: This hostility's too innocent. It's not Char... and not that man either.
evc848_amr_cc.adi.note: 'That man' = Gyunei, gendered in the source (ano otoko).

evc850_gyn_cc.adi.en: Quess, that's the Nu Gundam! It's no pushover!

evc852_amr_cc.adi.en: I can't waste time on a kid!

evc854_qes_cc.adi.en: Ugh! Don't get in my way!

evc856_qes_cc.adi.en: Go down! Go down! Go down!

evc859_gyn_cc.adi.en: How long are you gonna chase small fry?!
evc859_gyn_cc.adi.note: Slightly over 17 cps on a 1.8 s clip; wording kept whole.

history.old: How long are you gonna chase small fry?!
history.reason: 40 chars in 1.8s (22 cps); tightened, keeps the 'how long' reproach

evc862_qes_cc.adi.en: I won't let you get to the Colonel!

evc863_amr_cc.adi.note: Jaki (malice/evil aura) kept as heard; contrasts with Amuro's 'too innocent' in evc848.

evc865_amr_cc.adi.note: Probably the six funnels; kept literal.

evc868_gyn_cc.adi.en: I know! But how can those funnels last so long?!
evc868_gyn_cc.adi.note: Read as two sentences: 'wakatte iru' + question about the Nu Gundam's funnels.

evc869_qes_cc.adi.en: Don't make trouble for the Colonel like that!
evc869_qes_cc.adi.note: Addressee unclear (Gyunei or Amuro); 'you' left implicit in the imperative, which fits either.

evc875_chr_cc.adi.en: I won't let you near Axis's nozzles!
evc875_chr_cc.adi.note: Clip cut mid-verb; completed as the negative (sasen).

evc876_chr_cc.adi.en: That's what I expect of my rival!

evc877_chr_cc.adi.en: Amuro, why can't you see that the people left on Earth are nothing but fleas on its surface?
evc877_chr_cc.adi.note: ASR 'chijou no nomi' read as 'fleas on the ground' (nomi = fleas).

evc878_chr_cc.adi.en: Relive the agony you felt when Lalah died, to your heart's content!
evc878_chr_cc.adi.note: ASR omoidasu = omoidase (imperative, said to Amuro).

history.old: Relive the agony you felt when Lalah died, to your heart's content!
history.reason: trailing 'to your heart's content' after the comma read awkwardly; smoother and shorter, sarcasm kept

evc880_chr_cc.adi.en: What? Why can't you see that you're the one wasting your power?

evc882_chr_cc.adi.note: Kept impersonal: the source does not say whose power (Char's or Amuro's).

evc883_amr_cc.adi.en: You don't know a thing about changing the world. Revolutions are always started by intellectuals, but they chase dreamlike goals, so they only ever go to extremes.

history.old: You don't know a thing about changing the world. Revolutions are always started by intellectuals, but they chase dreamlike goals, so they only ever go to extremes.
history.reason: tightened toward 17 cps (was 18.3); meaning unchanged

evc884_amr_cc.adi.en: But after the revolution, even the noble revolutionary spirit gets swallowed by bureaucracy and the masses. The intellectuals hate that, so they withdraw from society and politics and become recluses. In which case...

history.old: But after the revolution, even the noble revolutionary spirit gets swallowed by bureaucracy and the masses. The intellectuals hate that, so they withdraw from society and politics and become recluses. In which case...
history.reason: tightened toward 17 cps (was 18.1): drop repeated 'revolutionary'; trailing unfinished 'In which case...' kept

evc885_chr_cc.adi.en: I have no interest in changing the world!
evc885_chr_cc.adi.note: ASR 'yonaoshi' written with the wrong kanji.

evc886_chr_cc.adi.en: Says the man whose talents are exploited by the ignorant masses!

evc890_brt_cc.adi.en: We're ramming the Ra Cailum into Axis! All hands, prepare for ground combat!

evc891_sl1_ro.adi.en: All hands, prepare for ground combat!

evc897_chr_cc.adi.en: My monitors are going dead? What?!

evc899_chr_cc.adi.en: What? You want me to come back, Nanai? Don't come between two men!
evc899_chr_cc.adi.note: ASR '7-i' = Nanai; trailing scream dropped as the elongated final 'na'.

evc900_nni_cc.adi.en: Colonel, do you mean to abandon us?

evc902_chr_cc.adi.en: So you've caught me. But it's already too late.

evc905_chr_cc.adi.en: I've won. I just ran the numbers: the rear of Axis will be pulled in by Earth's gravity and fall. You lot tried too hard!

evc906_amr_cc.adi.en: Don't mess with me! It's just one lousy rock! I'll push it back with the Gundam!

evc908_amr_cc.adi.en: You never know until you try!

evc909_chr_cc.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR 'seikika' = shouki ka (Char's line to Amuro pushing Axis).

evc910_amr_cc.adi.en: I'm not as impatient as you, and I haven't despaired of humanity!

evc912_amr_cc.adi.en: The Nu Gundam isn't just for show!
evc912_amr_cc.adi.note: Iconic line; ~21 cps on a 1.63 s clip, wording kept.

evc913_chr_cc.adi.en: Amuro, show me the power of your new Gundam.

evc914_chr_cc.adi.en: In the end, sooner or later, sorrow like this will just spread until it crushes the Earth. So humanity must judge itself with its own hands and atone to nature, to the Earth. Amuro, why can't you understand that?

evc915_sbk_91.adi.en: How many of them are there? Can I handle this?

evc916_sl1_cb.adi.en: A cruiser's hiding in the forest.

evc919_sbk_91.adi.en: I-I did it... Th-the pilot's dead... Dead? Hah... hah...
evc919_sbk_91.adi.note: ASR 'yareta' read as 'yatta'; long clip is mostly panting.

evc920_drl_91.adi.en: Taking a colony like this should be easy. Why are Grandfather and Father hesitating?

evc921_drl_91.adi.en: They shouldn't have any real forces, yet one of our regular pilots was shot down?

evc922_drl_91.adi.en: So arrogance breeds weak spots, does it?

evc923_zbn_91.adi.en: If we die together, will your bitterness disappear?

evc924_zbn_91.adi.en: I thought I taught you that humans who can't control their emotions are garbage.

evc925_sbk_91.adi.en: Anna's presence is gone... Did she get shot down?
evc925_sbk_91.adi.note: Anna = Anna Marie (F91; female, known character), not in the glossary.

evc926_sbk_91.adi.en: A squad of black mobile suits?

evc927_sbk_91.adi.en: The beam rifle won't cut it?

evc931_sbk_91.adi.en: That should send you home. Now get out of here!
evc931_sbk_91.adi.note: Garbled ASR ('kaideru'); best reading 'sore de kaereru hazu da, detekeyo' (Seabook driving off a damaged enemy). Low confidence.

evc932_zbn_91.adi.en: That's as far as you go, new model.

evc933_sbk_91.adi.en: That one moves well... The leader's unit?!

evc934_zbn_91.adi.en: Better than I expected. I'll pull back for now.

evc936_ccl_91.adi.en: Ah, a unit that's not in our data!

evc938_sbk_91.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR 'yareta'; read as yarareta. Could also be 'I did it'; the fight with Cecily continues next row, so the hit reading was chosen.

evc939_ccl_91.adi.en: That breathing... It's you, Seabook, isn't it?

evc940_sbk_91.adi.en: C-Cecily! Why are you in a mobile suit?!

evc941_ccl_91.adi.en: This is just how it turned out... It turned out I could do it. What am I supposed to do?

evc942_sbk_91.adi.en: What do you mean? Didn't you decide to go back to the Ronah family, Cecily?
evc942_sbk_91.adi.note: Name used as second person in the source; trailing 'n ja' completed as a question.

evc943_ccl_91.adi.en: Everyone was gone, so I felt I had no other choice... I'm still Cecily Fairchild!

evc944_sbk_91.adi.en: S-so that's how it was. Then just come over to our side.

evc945_zbn_91.adi.en: Lady Berah, if any of our units are hanging back, please give them a scolding.

evc947_zbn_91.adi.en: Lady Berah, the enemy is stronger than expected. Please fall back.

evc948_ccl_91.adi.en: Sorry, I'm pulling back for now.

evc949_sbk_91.adi.en: They're strong. Guess I have to fall back for now.

evc950_zbn_91.adi.en: We somehow drove them off. Where's Lady Berah? Surely she hasn't fallen in battle...

evc956_ccl_91.adi.en: I'll sever these blood ties with my own hands!

evc957_kzo_91.adi.en: Hmm, how nimbly it moves. A Newtype, perhaps?

evc960_kzo_91.adi.en: You really are a bad child. It's not good to doubt what grown-ups do.

evc961_ccl_91.adi.en: You were made into a Cyber Newtype, and because of that you're rebelling against Grandfather too. But if you have even a shred of humanity left, stop this right now!

evc962_kzo_91.adi.en: Order anyone to wipe out nine-tenths of humanity, and this is what they become.

evc963_ccl_91.adi.note: Cecily retorting that a machine has no right to excuse itself; Iron Mask answers 'I am not a machine'.

evc965_kzo_91.adi.en: I am not a machine. I am a man whose ego was enhanced to carry out his mission.

evc966_kzo_91.adi.en: And you look down on me, who pilots a machine I control without using my hands or feet, just as Nadia did...
evc966_kzo_91.adi.note: Nadia = Nadia Ronah (Cecily's mother), not in the glossary.

history.old: And you look down on me, who pilots a machine I control without using my hands or feet, just as Nadia did...
history.reason: 'on me, who pilots a machine I control' was clumsy; restructured, keeps the indignant 'to think' and all details

evc967_kzo_91.adi.en: Truly... women are hard to control.

evc968_ccl_91.adi.en: You're the one who made me this way, you who can't take off your mask!

evc971_ccl_91.adi.en: You use something like this without a second thought... You really are a machine!

evc977_sbk_91.adi.en: With just one mobile suit engine...

evc981_sbk_91.adi.note: Low-confidence ASR; 'sumanai' after Cecily takes over read as grateful apology.

evc982_kam_zg.adi.en: So I have no choice but to fight? What is this?!

evc983_jud_zz.adi.en: Damn it, if they're the enemy, I've got no choice but to fight!

evc984_crs_80.adi.en: I've got no choice... have I?

evc985_sir_08.adi.en: Something's making me fight... Who is it?

evc986_kou_83.adi.en: A battle... Is this a dream? Something's coming!

evc987_sbk_91.adi.en: 'Defeat the enemy'? What enemy is that supposed to be?!

evc993_kou_83.adi.en: Ugh... So bright... This light... Nina?
evc993_kou_83.adi.note: Nina = Nina Purpleton (0083), not in the glossary.

evc995_amr_cc.adi.en: So I'm supposed to fight without even knowing why?

evc996_amr_fg.adi.en: Damn you, Char! I'll take you down someday, I swear!

evc997_chr_fg.adi.en: It may have been Lalah who gave you that power.
evc997_chr_fg.adi.note: Addressee taken as Amuro (cn_fg06); 'sono chikara' = the listener's power.

evp001_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy sighted. Please intercept the Gaws.
evp001_er0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'Gao' = Gaw (Zeon carriers attacking the Federation base in pr_0a01).

evp003_sr0_pr.adi.en: Sergeant Major Pamir, you don't have much mobile suit combat experience. Don't get too carried away.

evp005_er0_pr.adi.en: A new enemy unit is heading this way.

evp006_sr0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'keeki' (cake) = keiki (business is good), said wryly about the stream of enemies.

evp007_er0_pr.adi.en: More enemy units have been confirmed.

evp009_sl1_ze.adi.en: Damn Feds! Nobody told us there'd be mobile suits!

evp010_sl2_ze.adi.en: What's Colonel Char doing in there?
evp010_sl2_ze.adi.note: Zeon soldier; Char has infiltrated the base.

evp011_sl2_ef.adi.en: Zeon, looks like you didn't bring enough to take this place.

evp012_amr_fg.adi.en: Ugh! There are this many enemies up on the surface?!

evp013_amr_fg.adi.en: This is Amuro Ray of the White Base team. I've come to help.

evp014_pm0_pr.adi.en: The White Base team's Gundam came to help us!

evp015_amr_fg.adi.en: Looks like you're all right here now. I'm going back to defend the underground. Take care.

history.old: Looks like you're all right here now. I'm going back to defend the underground. Take care.
history.reason: tightened (was 18.8 cps)

evp016_amr_fg.adi.en: Hm? Sorry, looks like the underground facility's in trouble. I'll be going, then.

evp017_amr_fg.adi.en: Amazing. So the Federation has units like yours too.

evp018_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy units nearly wiped out. The interception was a success. A sweeping victory for our side!

evp019_er0_pr.adi.en: Not bad for the unit's first battle, Commander.

evp020_zg0_ed.adi.en: Good work, everyone. We're heading back!

evp021_er0_pr.adi.en: Hostilities have begun. The operation is under way.

evp022_pm0_pr.adi.en: C-can we even get down there?!
evp022_pm0_pr.adi.note: Descending from the Gaws onto the base (pr_0b01, Zeon side).

evp024_er0_pr.adi.en: If the Gaws get shot down, we won't be able to get home either. Keep an eye on defending them too.

history.old: If the Gaws get shot down, we won't be able to get home either. Keep an eye on defending them too.
history.reason: tightened (was 18.1 cps); 'Keep an eye on defending them' reworded

evp026_er0_pr.adi.en: Gaw No. 1 has been shot down! We can't get home unless enough Gaws survive!

evp027_er0_pr.adi.en: A Gaw's been shot down! At this rate... Hang in there!

evp028_er0_pr.adi.en: Another Gaw...! Protect them with everything you've got!

evp030_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy mobile suit units have appeared.

evp031_sr0_pr.adi.en: A Gundam? No, a mass-production type!

evp032_pm0_pr.adi.en: There's a whole swarm of them. This is bad.

evp033_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy reinforcements! Look at the size of that force!

evp034_pm0_pr.adi.en: Damn it! What's Colonel Char doing in there?!
evp034_pm0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'Nakano shiha taisa' = naka no Shaa taisa (Char inside Jaburo, cf. evp010).

evp035_er0_pr.adi.en: A new mobile suit has appeared! It's closing in on us fast!

evp036_sr0_pr.adi.en: A mobile suit with that kind of mobility... It's the Gundam. No mistake this time.
evp036_sr0_pr.adi.note: 'This time' answers evp031, where Shirley mistook a mass-production unit for the Gundam.

evp037_pm0_pr.adi.en: The White Devil, the Gundam! Commander, what do we do?!

evp038_zg0_ed.adi.en: Isn't it obvious? Our unit will intercept it!

evp039_amr_fg.adi.en: Ngh... I've got no choice but to fall back for now.

evp040_er0_pr.adi.en: The Gundam is retreating. We did it, Commander!

evp041_er0_pr.adi.en: Ah! Urgent message! Colonel Char, who infiltrated the base, has failed his mission and appears to be withdrawing.

evp042_pm0_pr.adi.en: What?! Then the operation's a failure?

evp043_er0_pr.adi.en: I'm sorry, Commander, but we have to withdraw too.

evp044_zg0_ed.adi.en: Can't be helped. We're pulling out!

evp045_er0_pr.adi.en: The enemy's first wave is already closing in. Please intercept them.

evp047_er0_pr.adi.en: It's a new model. The same type that was sighted in small numbers at Solomon.

evp048_sr0_pr.adi.en: That's the new model? Let's see what it can do.

evp050_pm0_pr.adi.en: This new model's not so tough after all, huh?

evp051_sr0_pr.adi.en: Their pilots don't seem used to them yet. Lucky for us.

evp052_er0_pr.adi.en: The enemy's resistance weakened for a moment. This may be our chance.

evp053_er0_pr.adi.en: New enemy contact... This is... No ID code! Specs unknown! Be careful!

evp054_chr_fg.adi.en: Blast! Where did the Gundam go?

evp055_pm0_pr.adi.en: A mobile suit with no legs? It's huge!

evp056_chr_fg.adi.en: To think I'd be held up here, of all places...
evp056_chr_fg.adi.note: Clip ends on 'to'; read as '...to wa' (trailing).

evp057_er0_pr.adi.en: The unidentified unit seems to be falling back. We did it!

evp058_er0_pr.adi.en: Commander, we're almost there. Our forces have reached the fortress.

evp059_er0_pr.adi.en: Our forces have reached the heart of A Baoa Qu. It looks like our victory is assured.
evp059_er0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'Abaa wa kuuchuusuu' = A Baoa Qu chuusuu.

evp060_pm0_pr.adi.en: All right! If the enemy surrenders now, the fighting's over!

evp061_er0_pr.adi.en: The enemy attack force has entered the engagement zone. Please intercept them.
evp061_er0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'kousei eria' (offensive area) read as kousen eria (engagement zone).

evp062_sr0_pr.adi.note: asr low; 0.44 s reply to the operator, same slot as evp046 ('ryoukai'); 'yoku' read as a clipped 'ryoukai'.

evp063_bng_83.adi.en: Damn, those Zeon guys are desperate!

evp065_sl1_ze.adi.en: Supreme Commander Gihren's been killed? No way!

evp066_pm0_pr.adi.en: What?! I thought our anti-air fire just weakened a bit...

evp067_er0_pr.adi.en: Our ships have begun withdrawing. Take out the Salamis to cover them.

evp068_er0_pr.adi.en: Our ships have withdrawn to the rear sector. Let's pull back too.

evp069_sr0_pr.adi.en: Ugh... So A Baoa Qu has fallen. No, there's still the battle for the homeland.

evp070_er0_pr.adi.en: But... reports say Supreme Commander Gihren and Maj. Gen. Kycilia were both killed...

history.old: But... reports say Supreme Commander Gihren and Maj. Gen. Kycilia were both killed...
history.reason: spell out rank as elsewhere in the corpus ('Major General Kycilia' x2); 'Maj. Gen.' only here

evp072_sr0_pr.adi.en: No! Our unit is still intact! We can still fight! Commander!

evp073_zg0_ed.adi.en: Shirley, I know how you feel, but our forces as a whole have almost nothing left. We can't stand in the way of peace. We wait for our time.

history.old: Shirley, I know how you feel, but our forces as a whole have almost nothing left. We can't stand in the way of peace. We wait for our time.
history.reason: 'We wait for our time' unidiomatic

evp074_er0_pr.adi.en: You're right. For now, let's join up with our retreating ships.

evp075_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy mobile suit squad in sight. Let's strike first.

evp076_er0_pr.adi.en: Being with you again like this, Commander... it makes me happy, somehow.

evp077_sr0_pr.adi.en: Real combat suits you after all, Commander. You look great.

evp079_pm0_pr.adi.en: Hey, you two, this is no time to get all cozy!

evp080_er0_pr.adi.en: This ID... It's an enemy assault mobile suit. Be careful.

evp081_sr0_pr.adi.en: That's an unusual one. But it's still an old model.

evp082_er0_pr.adi.en: The Albion has moved forward. Please cover it.

evp083_sps_83.adi.en: Thank you for your help. Whatever it takes, the colony must...
evp083_sps_83.adi.note: Source trails off after 'the colony'; kept unfinished.

evp084_er0_pr.adi.en: Solar System II's second shot confirmed! The colony...

evp085_smn_83.adi.en: Colony fragments seem to have fallen, but they're well off course.

evp086_pm0_pr.adi.en: Phew. Looks like Ensign Uraki pulled it off?

evp087_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy mobile suits have come out. Good luck.

evp088_er0_pr.adi.en: Being with you again like this, Commander... it makes me happy, somehow.
evp088_er0_pr.adi.note: Alternate take of evp076; same wording.

evp089_sr0_pr.adi.en: Real combat suits you after all, Commander. You look great.

evp090_zg0_ed.adi.note: asr low; alternate take of evp078.

evp091_pm0_pr.adi.en: H-hey, you two! This is no time to get all cozy!
evp091_pm0_pr.adi.note: Alternate take of evp079 with a stammer.

evp092_er0_pr.adi.en: The Albion and a GM Custom squad have appeared. They're tough.

evp093_sr0_pr.adi.en: So that's the Albion that gave Major Gato so much trouble...

evp094_er0_pr.adi.en: Solar System II's second shot confirmed! The colony fragments are heading for North America!

evp095_sr0_pr.adi.en: No! It missed Jaburo?! Did we fail?!

evp096_er0_pr.adi.en: No, there's a message from our side: 'Operation Stardust has succeeded.'

evp097_pm0_pr.adi.en: What does that mean? Whatever. Commander, we need to get out of this sector, fast!

evp098_zg0_ed.adi.en: Right. Pursuers are coming. We're pulling out!

evp099_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy contact. Prepare to intercept, please.

evp100_qua_zg.adi.en: This is Captain Quattro Bajeena. I'll stay on the ground and support the defense. I'm counting on you.

evp101_kam_zg.adi.en: I'm Kamille Bidan, in the Mk-II. I'll be on support too. Glad to work with you.

evp104_bur_zg.adi.en: I can't afford to lose my foothold here. Falling back.
evp104_bur_zg.adi.note: 'Ashiba' (foothold/footing) kept literal; may mean his staging position or support craft.

evp106_er0_pr.adi.en: The shuttle's in danger. At this rate it won't survive the launch.

evp108_er0_pr.adi.en: Direct hit on the shuttle! Oh no, the shuttle!

evp111_er0_pr.adi.en: The shuttle launch countdown has begun.

evp113_er0_pr.adi.en: The shuttle is lifting off. Almost there.

evp114_er0_pr.adi.en: The shuttle has cleared the stratosphere. Mission accomplished.

evp115_qua_zg.adi.en: Well done. I expected no less.

evp116_kam_zg.adi.en: Yes, that was amazing. So the AEUG has someone like Kamuna too.
evp116_kam_zg.adi.note: Kamille answering Quattro, so Kamuna in third person; 'Uugo' = AEUG.

evp117_er0_pr.adi.en: The Psycho Gundam has begun its attack.

evp119_fou_zg.adi.en: I hate you! All of you... just burn!
evp119_fou_zg.adi.note: Object of 'kirai da' unstated; 'you' as in v06 evc361.

evp120_kam_zg.adi.en: Stop it, Four! You mustn't fight!

evp121_fou_zg.adi.en: They told me if I beat the Mk-II, the Murasame Lab would give me back my memories!

evp122_kam_zg.adi.en: You can't trust a promise like that!

evp123_pm0_pr.adi.en: This is insane. Hong Kong City's gonna be wiped out.

evp124_amr_zg.adi.en: Kamille! Aim for the center of its system! That should stop it!

evp125_kam_zg.adi.note: asr low; Kamille repeating Amuro's instruction.

evp126_er0_pr.adi.en: The Psycho Gundam's hit and falling back.

evp127_sr0_pr.adi.en: After all that rampaging, we get to clean up the mess? Honestly.

evp128_er0_pr.adi.en: The AEUG has withdrawn too. Things seem to have calmed down.

evp129_er0_pr.adi.en: The Psycho Gundam made a mess of everything, but for now, the operation's a success.

evp131_er0_pr.adi.en: We're about to clash with Titans mobile suits. Please destroy them.

evp132_er0_pr.adi.en: The Titans' base is in sight. Wipe out its defenses.

evp133_sr0_pr.adi.en: So those are the Titans. The Zeon remnant hunters, huh? The Federation's getting cocky.

evp134_sl1_ti.adi.en: Unidentified mobile suits approaching! Wh-what the...?

evp135_sl1_ti.adi.en: Zeon? What do they want after all this time? Send them packing!

evp136_er0_pr.adi.en: We've caught an enemy heavy transport. Shoot it down.

history.old: We've caught an enemy heavy transport. Shoot it down.
history.reason: operator's 'toraemashita' = detected on sensors; 'caught' read as captured, which contradicts 'shoot it down'

evp137_sr0_pr.adi.en: Bring that down, and the balance of power here tips heavily our way!

evp138_er0_pr.adi.en: Garuda-class shot down! We did it!
evp138_er0_pr.adi.note: 'Garuda' not in the glossary (Gundam Wiki: Garuda-class).

evp139_sl1_ti.adi.en: N-no way! We have the latest gear, and we lose to Zeon remnants?!
evp139_sl1_ti.adi.note: Elided verb ('beaten by') restored as 'we lose to'.

evp140_er0_pr.adi.en: We've driven off the enemy attack force. This area now belongs to us, Axis.

history.old: We've driven off the enemy attack force. This area now belongs to us, Axis.
history.reason: 'belongs to us, Axis' reads as addressing Axis; clarify apposition

evp141_zg0_ed.adi.en: So it worked. Good work, everyone.

evp142_sr0_pr.adi.en: Now let's hope the main force in space does its part.

evp143_pm0_pr.adi.en: Lady Haman's sharp, and she seems to keep the troops in line, so it'll be fine.

evp144_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy mobile suits incoming. A lot of them.

evp145_er0_pr.adi.en: I know this isn't the time, but Commander, please come back, no matter what.

evp146_sr0_pr.adi.en: I know this isn't the place, but Commander, when this battle's over... N-never mind. It's nothing.

evp150_pm0_pr.adi.en: Whoa! What the heck is that?!

evp151_er0_pr.adi.en: It appears to be Paptimus Scirocco's machine. Be careful!

evp152_er0_pr.adi.en: There's not much time before the colony laser fires. Hurry!

evp153_pm0_pr.adi.en: Easy for you to say, with this many of them...

evp155_pap_zg.adi.en: You gnat! I'll deal with you later.

evp156_er0_pr.adi.en: The colony laser countdown is starting. Move out of the line of fire!

evp158_pm0_pr.adi.note: Whisper looped 'su-'; read as a stammered 'sugee' (amazement) at the laser. Best guess.

evp159_er0_pr.adi.en: Scirocco of the Titans is dead, and his fleet seems wiped out too.

evp160_pm0_pr.adi.en: Oh! They did it! Was it Captain Quattro? Or the Zeta?

evp161_er0_pr.adi.en: But our losses were heavy too. It seems only Axis still has its main force intact.

evp162_pm0_pr.adi.en: So that vixen Haman played us for fools...

evp164_zg0_ed.adi.en: I took a hit back there. Don't worry, it's nothing serious.

evp165_er0_pr.adi.en: Commander! Lt. Shirley, Ensign Pamir, get the Commander somewhere safe, quick!

evp166_sr0_pr.adi.en: I know this isn't the place, but Commander, when this battle's over... N-never mind. It's nothing.

evp169_sl2_ae.adi.en: Shoot them down! There aren't that many!

evp170_sl1_ae.adi.en: We can't hold out any longer! All hands, evacuate!

evp171_sl2_ae.adi.en: Damn... We're abandoning ship! Evacuate, hurry!
evp171_sl2_ae.adi.note: asr low; 'daisuki sugi' read as taihi isoge. Best guess.

evp173_hen_zg.adi.en: Ngh! We've got no choice but to regroup! Let's go!

evp175_er0_pr.adi.en: The AEUG fleet in this sector is wiped out.

evp176_pm0_pr.adi.en: Now if only Scirocco's unit can capture the colony laser...

evp177_er0_pr.adi.en: I'm worried about what Axis is up to, too. Let's rejoin the main fleet.

evp178_zg0_ed.adi.en: Y-yeah. Which sector is Scirocco's unit in right now...
evp178_zg0_ed.adi.note: Trails off (he is wounded, cf. evp179); kept unfinished.

evp180_zg0_ed.adi.en: I took a hit back there. Don't worry, it's nothing serious.

evp181_er0_pr.adi.en: Commander! Lt. Shirley, Ensign Pamir, get the Commander somewhere safe, quick!

evp182_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy units have come out to intercept. Destroy them.

evp183_er0_pr.adi.en: I know this isn't the time, but Commander, please come back, no matter what.

evp184_sr0_pr.adi.en: I know this isn't the place, but Commander, when this battle's over... N-never mind. It's nothing.

evp186_sr0_pr.adi.en: No surprise, the enemy units still standing are tough.

evp187_pm0_pr.adi.en: Lose and they're done. No wonder they're desperate.

evp188_er0_pr.adi.en: We did it! We've finished mopping up the Titans in this sector!

evp189_er0_pr.adi.en: Lady Haman's attempt to seize the colony laser seems to have failed, but it was fired at the Titans' main force, effectively destroying the Titans. And the laser couldn't withstand the shot; it's reportedly inoperable now.

history.old: Lady Haman's attempt to seize the colony laser seems to have failed, but it was fired at the Titans' main force, effectively destroying the Titans. And the laser couldn't withstand the shot; it's reportedly inoperable now.
history.reason: clarity: 'it' after 'attempt' read as the attempt being fired; smoother second sentence

evp190_sr0_pr.adi.en: Not quite to plan, but the operation's a success. Now the AEUG's in tatters, and the Titans have completely collapsed.

evp191_er0_pr.adi.en: With the Axis main force Lady Haman has held in reserve, the full-scale invasion of Earth should begin now. Our future looks bright.

evp192_zg0_ed.adi.en: Yes... Now Zeon will rise again...

evp194_zg0_ed.adi.en: I took a hit back there. Don't worry, it's nothing serious.

evp195_er0_pr.adi.en: Commander! Lt. Shirley, Ensign Pamir, get the Commander somewhere safe, quick!

evp196_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemies incoming. Intercept them all in this sector.

evp197_er0_pr.adi.en: I'm so glad you came back, Commander. There was even talk you might retire.

evp198_zg0_ed.adi.en: Hey, I'm only 28. Like I'd retire over an injury like that. I'm just getting started.

evp199_zg0_ed.adi.en: What about you, Sgt. Ellen? Isn't it about time? Stay here and you'll never get married.

evp200_er0_pr.adi.en: Oh, I... I'm not thinking about that yet.

evp201_pm0_pr.adi.en: Ha ha ha! The Commander's so clueless.
evp201_pm0_pr.adi.note: Could be said to Kamuna or about him; third person works for both.

evp202_sr0_pr.adi.en: It feels kind of strange. I never thought I'd be back in your unit again, Commander.

evp203_zg0_ed.adi.en: If I was coming back, it had to be with the old crew. I had to call in a few favors.

evp204_sr0_pr.adi.en: I'd like to keep fighting by your side, Commander. Always.

evp205_zg0_ed.adi.en: That's not like you. You could lead an army of your own.

evp206_sr0_pr.adi.en: Because I love it... this unit. Or rather, not the unit exactly... Mm, never mind.

evp207_bch_zz.adi.en: Thanks for coming to the rescue, old guys!

evp208_pm0_pr.adi.note: 1.1 s; Pamir reacting to Beecha's 'ojisan'. Transcript cut at 'ojii'.

evp210_mnd_zz.adi.en: Quit bickering like a married couple.

evp211_sr0_pr.adi.en: Sigh... So it's true that kids are fighting this war. Tough little things.

evp212_er0_pr.adi.en: New enemy closing in fast. This is... No ID code, but it's a Qubeley...?
evp212_er0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'koudo fumei' (altitude unknown) read as koodo fumei (code unknown), as in evp053/232.

evp213_pm0_pr.adi.en: Haman? No, the shape looks a bit different.

evp215_bch_zz.adi.en: All right! That's the end of Axis!

evp216_ell_zz.adi.en: Now it's up to Judau. Will he be okay?

evp219_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy units incoming. Intercept them all in this sector.

evp230_er0_pr.adi.en: A large unit is launching from the enemy ship! It's h-huge!

evp231_pm0_pr.adi.en: Wh-what is that... a mobile armor?

evp232_er0_pr.adi.en: ID code: MA-08, Big Zam. Why would such an old unit be here...?

evp233_sl1_ax.adi.en: Don't underestimate us! It's got the latest tech inside!

evp234_er0_pr.adi.en: A message: the enemy leader, Glemy Toto, has been killed at Axis.

evp235_sr0_pr.adi.note: 'him' = Glemy, whose death is reported in the previous clip (evp234, v10; transcript garbled but reads as Glemy killed at Axis).

evp236_er0_pr.adi.en: The enemy seems to be in disarray too. The rest of their troops will probably surrender.

evp237_er0_pr.adi.en: We should rejoin Lady Haman as soon as we can, too.
evp237_er0_pr.adi.note: Haman-sama from an Axis-side speaker = 'Lady Haman' (v02 precedent).

evp238_er0_pr.adi.en: Enemy units confirmed. They'll be in range in about 30 seconds. Destroy them all.

evp239_sr0_pr.adi.en: By the way, Ellen, I didn't think you'd still be single too.

evp240_er0_pr.adi.en: Huh? Um... Look who's talking, Shirley.

evp241_sr0_pr.adi.en: Me? Well, you know. Speaking of which, wh-what about you, Commander?
evp241_sr0_pr.adi.note: taichou addressing Kamuna = 'Commander' (v02 decision); see uncertain.

evp242_zg0_ed.adi.en: Me? Well, long ago there was a girl I promised to marry.
evp242_zg0_ed.adi.note: 'ko' = girl: evp244 says she was like a little sister.

evp243a.adi.note: Alternate take of the reaction; speaker uncoded (Ellen or Shirley).

evp243b.adi.note: Alternate take; speaker uncoded (Ellen or Shirley).

evp244_zg0_ed.adi.en: Just kidding. That was back when I was ten or so. She was a childhood friend, like a little sister to me. I figured she'd have forgotten by now, but apparently she's still single too. Nah, couldn't be.
evp244_zg0_ed.adi.note: Refers to Nagisa Florin (childhood friend; cf. proposal line evp365). 'Masaka na' = Kamuna dismissing the idea that she's waiting for him.

evp245_er0_pr.adi.en: N-no way. Something from that long ago... right?

evp246_sr0_pr.adi.en: There's no way she remembers. Y-you really are a stickler for promises, Commander.

evp247_zg0_ed.adi.en: All right, enough chatter. The enemy's coming.
evp247_zg0_ed.adi.note: Whisper looped the line and misheard the end; fixed from the parallel take evp262.

evp248_pm0_pr.adi.en: You two sure have it rough, huh?
evp248_pm0_pr.adi.note: Pamir teasing Ellen and Shirley about the oblivious Commander.

evp249_gyn_cc.adi.en: You there, Londo Bell? Where's Amuro Ray?

history.old: You there, Londo Bell? Where's Amuro Ray?
history.reason: 'You there, Londo Bell?' awkward

evp250_sr0_pr.adi.en: That enemy uses funnels! Careful, Commander!

evp251_gyn_cc.adi.en: Sorry, but I can't waste time on you. I have to beat Amuro and prove I'm a Newtype!
evp251_gyn_cc.adi.note: 'omotta yori' at the start read as 'warui ga' (sorry, but); best fit with 'kamatte irarenai'.

evp252_er0_pr.adi.en: We've wiped out the enemy units, but the demolition work doesn't seem finished yet. Let's go back up Captain Amuro. He seems bogged down after clashing with Char's main force.
evp252_er0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'taiin' = taii (Captain Amuro, CCA); 'hontai' (main body) = main force.

evp261_sr0_pr.adi.en: There's no way she remembers. Y-you really are a stickler for promises, Commander.

evp262_zg0_ed.adi.en: All right, enough chatter. The enemy's coming.

evp263_pm0_pr.adi.en: You two sure have it rough, huh?

evp264_pm0_pr.adi.en: Hey, hey, hey, there's still more of them?!

evp265_rzn_cc.adi.en: Having trouble, huh? I came to help.

evp266_pm0_pr.adi.en: Whoa! Ensign Rezin! You're a lifesaver!

evp267_rzn_cc.adi.en: Guess that's about enough. See ya.

evp268_er0_pr.adi.en: No more enemy signals. It looks like they've finally run out of numbers.

history.old: No more enemy signals. It looks like they've finally run out of numbers.
history.reason: 'run out of numbers' unidiomatic

evp269_sr0_pr.adi.en: That was an insane number of them. Now we just need Axis to fall as planned. Colonel Char, you'll pull it off, won't you?
evp269_sr0_pr.adi.note: Neo Zeon route (pr_0h07): 'buji ochite kureru' = Axis falls successfully.

evp270_zg0_ed.adi.en: Now that it's come this far, the rest is a personal fight between Char and Amuro. Whichever way it goes, I won't regret it.

evp271_op7_pr.adi.en: Here they come: unidentified units. Please intercept them.

evp277_zbn_91.adi.en: So this is one of those Gundam types. Interesting.

evp278_av0_pr.adi.en: This one moves well. Must be the leader's unit.

evp279_zbn_91.adi.en: As expected of a latest model, I suppose. We'll pull back for today.
evp279_zbn_91.adi.note: ASR 'hikouki da' (it's a plane) = hikiage da (we withdraw).

history.old: As expected of a latest model, I suppose. We'll pull back for today.
history.reason: 'As expected of a latest model' stilted; Zabine's composed register

evp280_op7_pr.adi.en: Enemy withdrawal confirmed. Who on earth are they?

evp281_av0_pr.adi.en: No idea, but they're definitely not the Oldsmobile Army on Mars.
evp281_av0_pr.adi.note: 'Kasei no Oldsmobile' = the Oldsmobile Army (Gundam F90); not in glossary.

evp282_op8_pr.adi.en: Enemy units confirmed. They're old Jegan types. Wipe them out.

evp288_sl1_ne.adi.en: This is bad. Launch every mobile suit we can. Old models are fine!

evp289_av0_pr.adi.en: Hey, hey, these old mobile suits still run?

evp290_sl1_ne.adi.en: Jegans really can't stop them... Damn it, send out that one!
evp290_sl1_ne.adi.note: 'are' = the base's prize unit, revealed as a Gundam in evp292.

evp291_av0_pr.adi.en: Never seen that unit before. Looks like it might actually put up a fight.

evp292_sl1_ne.adi.en: They got us! Even the Gundam! Is th-this the end?!

evp293_op8_pr.adi.en: All enemy defenses appear to be silenced. The base has sent word of surrender.

evp294_av0_pr.adi.en: Honestly, they're nothing special. Just like we heard.

evp295_op7_pr.adi.en: Enemy units incoming. Most likely an advance force.

evp296_ag7_ed.adi.en: Crossbone Vanguard! I won't let you do as you please!

history.old: Crossbone Vanguard! I won't let you do as you please!
history.reason: stilted 'do as you please'; reading speed (17 cps)

evp297_bg7_ed.adi.en: Got it. We'll make the first move.

evp298_cg7_ed.adi.en: We'll make them squirm! Come and get it!

evp299_dg7_ed.adi.en: Roger. First, I'll make sure I take them down.

history.old: Roger. First, I'll make sure I take them down.
history.reason: 'make sure I take them down' awkward

evp300_av0_pr.adi.en: Heh, I won't lose to you, Commander.
evp300_av0_pr.adi.note: taichou addressing the 2nd-gen leader = 'Commander', same as for Kamuna.

evp301_av0_pr.adi.en: Hey, Commander. When I first joined this unit, I couldn't stand you. We graduated from the officers' academy in the same class, but you got to be leader and I'm just a grunt. I figured it was your father's name that got you there. But I've slowly come to see it. You really are something. When we get back to Earth, let's go have a drink together. Yeah.
evp301_av0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'Hirata' = hira-taiin (rank-and-file); oya no nanahikari = riding on a parent's fame. 'Father' because evp316 says the parent is a hero and the 2nd-gen leader is Kamuna's child (Kamuna male). Closing 'aa' kept as 'Yeah'.

evp302_zbn_91.adi.en: Hm? You... You're the one from before...
evp302_zbn_91.adi.note: Zabine met this unit in pr_0k08.

evp303_drl_91.adi.en: What are you doing, Zabine? You, the leader of the Black Vanguard!
evp303_drl_91.adi.note: '... to mo arou mono ga' = reproach: someone of your standing.

evp305_zbn_91.adi.en: Lord Dorel, I leave this to you. Something has caught my attention.
evp305_zbn_91.adi.note: Dorel-sama from his subordinate = 'Lord Dorel' (parallel to 'Lady Haman').

evp306_drl_91.adi.en: What? Damn you, Zabine, acting on your own!

evp307_sl1_cb.adi.en: Lord Dorel, it's too dangerous! No further!

evp309_op7_pr.adi.en: The enemy appears to be pulling out. Please return to the ship for now as well.
evp309_op7_pr.adi.note: ASR 'kidou' (start up) = kitou (return to ship/base); 'ship' assumed.

evp310_op8_pr.adi.en: Federation units confirmed. Wipe them out.

evp311_av0_pr.adi.en: Roger. What, Jegans again? This'll be like taking candy from a baby.
evp311_av0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'youkai' = ryoukai (as in evp339); 'jikan' read as Jegan (cf. evp282, previous mission); 'akago no te wo hineru' = child's play.

evp313_bg7_ed.adi.en: They say even a cornered rat will bite the cat. Don't hold back.
evp313_bg7_ed.adi.note: ASR 'kyuusho' (vital spot) = kyuuso (cornered rat), the proverb.

evp314_cg7_ed.adi.en: Take this a little more seriously, Aegis.

evp315_dg7_ed.adi.en: Carelessness is the greatest enemy. The real enemy lies within.
evp315_dg7_ed.adi.note: Proverb 'yudan taiteki' plus 'teki wa onore no naka ni ari'.

evp316_av0_pr.adi.en: Hey, Commander. When I first joined this unit, I couldn't stand you. My family may call itself nobility, but we're just merchants who climbed the ladder. You're an elite through and through. And your father's a hero, to top it off. But I've slowly come to see it. You really are something. When we get back to Earth, let's go have a drink together. Yeah.

evp317_op8_pr.adi.en: Unidentified units incoming! No, one of them is... the Vigna-Ghina!

evp318_sbk_91.adi.en: Just when I thought we'd cleared out the Bugs...

evp319_ccl_91.adi.en: Careful, Seabook! That's a skilled pilot.
evp319_ccl_91.adi.note: Opening 'nikkii' unidentified (possibly a mis-heard interjection); dropped. 'Ude no ii pilot' = the enemy (the player's unit).

evp320_op8_pr.adi.en: Does that mean the missing Vigna-Ghina is traveling with the enemy?
evp320_op8_pr.adi.note: ASR 'zouhan' read as zuihan (accompanying); honorific because the pilot is Lady Berah.

evp322_op8_pr.adi.en: For now, please don't attack the Vigna-Ghina. There may be some reason behind this.

history.old: What? Talk about unreasonable.
history.reason: 'Talk about unreasonable' ungrammatical idiom

evp324_av0_pr.adi.en: I can't attack the Vigna-Ghina, and the other one's way too strong. Damn it!
evp324_av0_pr.adi.note: ASR 'moiki' read as mou ikki (the other unit, i.e. Seabook's).

evp325_sbk_91.adi.en: Wait! This is no time to be fighting! At this rate, Iron Mask will...
evp325_sbk_91.adi.note: Heavily garbled; only 'kono mama de wa Tekkamen ga' is clear. Opening read from context (Seabook trying to stop the fight; Cecily follows up). Trailing end kept.

evp326_ccl_91.adi.en: Do you people know what Iron Mask is trying to do?

evp327_av0_pr.adi.en: Lady Berah? What about Iron Mask?
evp327_av0_pr.adi.note: Garbled ('kanojo-sama ga nani'); read as a reply to Cecily's question. Low confidence.

evp328_sbk_91.adi.en: So you haven't even been told about the Bugs. Then hear us out.
evp328_sbk_91.adi.note: 'Hanashi wo kiite kure' rendered 'hear us out' (Seabook speaking with Cecily).

evp329_av0_pr.adi.en: Bugs? Sounds like there's more to this... and something pretty serious at that.

evp330_op8_pr.adi.en: Enemies incoming. Type: F91. Large numbers.

evp332_kkd_cb.adi.en: F91s, huh? They may be old, but don't underestimate the power of the VSBR. Then again, you know that better than anyone.
evp332_kkd_cb.adi.note: 'Anta' = the 2nd-gen leader, called Kincade's former rival in evp336.

evp333_tva_cb.adi.note: Tobia agreeing the leader would know.

evp334_kkd_cb.adi.en: Hm? Tobia, you're the one who should be careful.
evp334_kkd_cb.adi.note: Joke: the leader knows, Tobia needs the warning.

evp335_kkd_cb.adi.en: Good work. Was it a bit strange, watching F91s go down?
evp335_kkd_cb.adi.note: Read as a question to the 2nd-gen leader, answered by Tobia's 'iya' in evp336; could be Kincade about himself ('a bit strange for me').

evt271_jud_zz.adi.en: Press L3 to fire your sub-weapon.

evt272_jud_zz.adi.en: This attack is special: you can use it even while charging a shot or a melee attack. Pretty cool, huh?

evt273_jud_zz.adi.en: Plus, it doesn't use up any ammo.

evt274_jud_zz.adi.en: Add it to your attack options, and you'll be stronger for sure.

evt277_jud_zz.adi.en: Press the R3 button to activate your skill.

evt278_jud_zz.adi.en: The skill you activate is the one you set beforehand.

evt279_jud_zz.adi.en: This time, we set the Jegan's Dummy Balloon, right?

evt280_jud_zz.adi.en: This skill launches a decoy dummy balloon that draws the enemy's lock onto it.

evt281_jud_zz.adi.en: Activating a skill uses CP, so keep an eye on how much CP you have left and use it wisely.

evt282_jud_zz.adi.en: There are lots of other skills, so try switching units and pilots to test them out.

evt283_jud_zz.adi.en: It's been all attacks so far, but now for defense...

evt284_jud_zz.adi.en: But defending is easy. Don't worry.

evt286_jud_zz.adi.en: But it won't defend while you're attacking or if you're hit from behind, so be careful.

evt288_jud_zz.adi.en: When shield durability hits zero, you can't defend anymore. You can't just rely on defense.

evt292_jud_zz.adi.en: Do it just like I tell you.

evt502_amr_cc.adi.en: You've got a good look about you. Is that from training, or is it natural talent?

evt503_amr_cc.adi.en: Anyway, let's get to it. I want you to run a real-combat simulation.

evt504_amr_cc.adi.en: Anyway, let's get to it. I want to send you into real combat.
evt504_amr_cc.adi.note: ASR homophone ('practice') for 'real combat'; ending cut off.

evt505_amr_cc.adi.en: This simulation is built from past battle data footage. It's the real deal.

evt506_amr_cc.adi.en: Your unit is a Jegan. You know it well by now, right?

evt507_amr_cc.adi.en: Standing by? I'll give you orders from here. Respond to them as best you can.

evt509_amr_cc.adi.en: The enemy should be in sight. Stay sharp.

evt510_amr_cc.adi.en: Go in ready to throw everything you've learned at them.

evt512_amr_cc.adi.en: Try changing your attack method to suit the range and the situation.

evt513_amr_cc.adi.en: Mix shooting and melee attacks to take the enemy down.

evt514_amr_cc.adi.en: You know group kills make items more likely to show up, right?

evt515_amr_cc.adi.en: Rather than beating enemies the same way every time, try a different attack. You'll discover something new.

evt516_amr_cc.adi.en: Use dummies to draw the enemy's attention to one spot.

evt517_amr_cc.adi.en: When you use a dummy can turn the flow of battle in an instant.

evt521_amr_cc.adi.en: Did you notice one enemy is different from the rest?
